title: The Sunday Read: 'A Mother and Daughter at the End'

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Sam Anderson, and I am a staff writer for the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫萨姆·安德森，《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: And this week, I wrote a cover story about my time with the last two northern white rhinos on planet
sentences.zh: 本周，我写了一篇封面故事，记录了我与地球上最后两头北方白犀牛共度的时光

sentences.en: Earth.
sentences.zh: 地球。

sentences.en: So this story really started with sadness.
sentences.zh: 所以这个故事其实始于悲伤。

sentences.en: I was sitting around feeling doomed and gloomy about the state of the world.
sentences.zh: 我当时坐在那儿，对世界的现状感到末日降临般的沮丧和阴暗。

sentences.en: You know, I was looking at these huge problems, climate change, systemic racism.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时在看这些巨大的问题，气候变化、系统性种族主义。

sentences.en: I was feeling really hopeless.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常绝望。

sentences.en: And in that cloud of gloom, I remembered a story I had read about this subspecies of rhinoceros in Africa that was going extinct.
sentences.zh: 在那片阴霾中，我想起曾读过的一个故事，关于非洲这种正在走向灭绝的犀牛亚种。

sentences.en: The last male northern white rhino died in 2018.
sentences.zh: 最后一头雄性北方白犀牛于 2018 年去世。

sentences.en: His name was Sudan.
sentences.zh: 它的名字叫苏丹。

sentences.en: And this was a huge deal because when the last male dies, suddenly you can't reproduce anymore.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事，因为当最后一只雄性死去时，你突然就无法再繁殖了。

sentences.en: And so the species tipped over into a category called functional extinction.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个物种陷入了一个被称为功能性灭绝的类别。

sentences.en: You know, there may be one or two left, but they're not really, they don't have a future in the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，可能还剩一两只，但它们真的没有了，它们在这个世界上没有未来了。

sentences.en: I thought a lot about this functionally extinct rhino.
sentences.zh: 我思考了很多关于这头功能性灭绝的犀牛的事情。

sentences.en: And then the fact that my mind really seized on was that there were still two of these rhinos left, both female, a mother and a daughter.
sentences.zh: 然后，我脑海中真正挥之不去的事实是，这里居然还剩两头这样的犀牛，而且都是雌性，一对母女。

sentences.en: And I just had this overwhelming urge to go and see them.
sentences.zh: 我当时就有一种不可遏制的冲动想去看看它们。

sentences.en: And so I went to Kenya and I spent a week out in the field with the girls.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了肯尼亚，和这俩姑娘在野外度过了一个星期。

sentences.en: Everybody calls them the girls, the last two.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫它们姑娘，最后剩下的两只。

sentences.en: It's Najin, who's the mom, and Fatu, who's the daughter.
sentences.zh: 那是妈妈纳金，还有女儿法图。

sentences.en: These are huge creatures, the size of a thing that modern humans are not used to seeing.
sentences.zh: 这些都是巨大的生物，其体型是现代人类不常看到的。

sentences.en: Like we expect, you know, I don't know, SUVs to be this size or something, not living animals.
sentences.zh: 就像我们期待的那样，你知道的，我不知道，SUV应该是这个尺寸的，而不是活生生的动物。

sentences.en: And yet here they are trundling up, munching on grass.
sentences.zh: 然而它们就在这里慢吞吞地走着，咀嚼着青草。

sentences.en: They've got this really thick, dry, cracked looking skin.
sentences.zh: 它们有着非常厚、干燥、看起来开裂的皮肤。

sentences.en: They've got these huge horns, gigantic snouts, perfectly designed for eating grass that they can press against the ground.
sentences.zh: 它们长着巨大的角，硕大的吻部，非常适合吃草，可以紧贴地面。

sentences.en: And so I got to stand out there with them.
sentences.zh: 于是我有幸和它们一起站在那里。

sentences.en: And what I found was that it didn't feel tragic.
sentences.zh: 我发现这并没有让我感到悲剧色彩。

sentences.en: It made me feel really happy.
sentences.zh: 它让我感到非常快乐。

sentences.en: Here were these two individual creatures that were just living their lives and experiencing the regular daily pleasures that rhinos have always experienced.
sentences.zh: 这里有两头独立的生物，它们只是在过着自己的生活，体验着犀牛们一直以来所经历的日常乐趣。

sentences.en: They come out in the morning and it's dawn and there's this huge, beautiful, low orange sun rising over Mount Kenya.
sentences.zh: 它们在清晨破晓时分出来，一轮巨大、美丽、低矮的橙色太阳在肯尼亚山上方升起。

sentences.en: They're just kind of enjoying that warmth.
sentences.zh: 它们只是在享受那种温暖。

sentences.en: They scratch themselves on their scratching post for five minutes at a time.
sentences.zh: 它们在抓痒桩上一次蹭上好几分钟。

sentences.en: And you can hear that wood creaking.
sentences.zh: 你能听到木头的吱呀声。

sentences.en: And they have this wonderful bond with their caretakers who kind of pat them down every morning.
sentences.zh: 它们与照料者有着极好的纽带，照料者每天早晨都会轻轻拍打它们的身体。

sentences.en: And they seem happy.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来很高兴。

sentences.en: I mean, they seem like normal living mammals, which I guess against the backdrop of that terrible story
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们看起来就像普通的活哺乳动物，我想在它们灭绝和衰落的可怕故事的背景下，

sentences.en: of their extinction and decline, just felt really wonderful and life affirming.
sentences.zh: 这让人感觉非常奇妙，且充满生命力。

sentences.en: I, as a human being, am in my end times.
sentences.zh: 作为一个人类，我正处于我生命的晚期。

sentences.en: I'm a middle-aged man.
sentences.zh: 我是一个中年男子。

sentences.en: And I was in my end times from the moment I was born, really.
sentences.zh: 其实，从我出生那一刻起，我就已经进入了生命的晚期。

sentences.en: We all are.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都是如此。

sentences.en: And I think that that is that classic Buddhist wisdom of all we have is now.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是经典的佛教智慧：我们拥有的全部只有当下。

sentences.en: The only thing that's really permanent is impermanence, is transience.
sentences.zh: 唯一真正永恒的是无常，是短暂。

sentences.en: And so being with the girls, it made me think a lot about the biggest questions in life, but also the
sentences.zh: 因此，和姑娘们在一起的时光，让我思考了很多关于生活中最宏大的问题，还有

sentences.en: smallest things in life and how those, those two things are braided together really.
sentences.zh: 生活中最微小的事情，以及这两者是如何真正交织在一起的。

sentences.en: So, you know, our mortality, but also the daily pleasures, you know, morning coffee with my wife.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我们的终有一死，还有日常的快乐，你知道的，和妻子一起喝早咖啡。

sentences.en: I think I take a lot more pleasure in now.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在能从更多的事情中获得乐趣。

sentences.en: I definitely notice my dogs.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会注意到我的狗。

sentences.en: I feel their furry foreheads and I just kind of share these long gazes with them now.
sentences.zh: 我摸着它们毛茸茸的前额，现在我只是和它们进行这种长久的凝视。

sentences.en: And I think about the rhinos because we have this moment.
sentences.zh: 我想到了犀牛，因为我们拥有这一刻。

sentences.en: I have this moment with these creatures in my home and with my family.
sentences.zh: 我和这些生物在我的家中、和我的家人在一起度过了这一刻。

sentences.en: And I take a hot shower and it feels great.
sentences.zh: 我洗了个热水澡，感觉棒极了。

sentences.en: And I think I appreciate those things more since I spent that week with the last two northern white rhinos.
sentences.zh: 我想自从我在那儿与最后两头北方白犀牛度过那一周之后，我更加感激这些事情了。

sentences.en: So here's my story, A Mother and Daughter at the End, read by Eduardo Ballerini.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的故事，《末日母女》，由爱德华多·巴勒里尼为您朗读。

sentences.en: The day Sudan died, everything felt both monumental and ordinary.
sentences.zh: 苏丹死的那天，一切既显得意义重大又平淡无奇。

sentences.en: It was a Monday.
sentences.zh: 那是一个星期一。

sentences.en: Gray sky, light rain.
sentences.zh: 灰蒙蒙的天空，下着小雨。

sentences.en: On the horizon, the sun was struggling to make itself seen over the sharp double peaks of Mount Kenya.
sentences.zh: 在地平线上，太阳正挣扎着在肯尼亚山尖锐的双峰之上露面。

sentences.en: Little black-faced monkeys came skittering in over the fence to try to steal the morning carrots.
sentences.zh: 小黑脸猴子吱吱叫着穿过栅栏，试图偷走早晨的胡萝卜。

sentences.en: Metal gates creaked and clanked.
sentences.zh: 金属大门发出吱吱嘎嘎的声响。

sentences.en: Men spoke in quiet Swahili.
sentences.zh: 男人们用低沉的斯瓦希里语交谈着。

sentences.en: Sudan lay still in the dirt.
sentences.zh: 苏丹静静地躺在泥土中。

sentences.en: Thick legs folded under him.
sentences.zh: 粗壮的腿蜷缩在身下。

sentences.en: Huge head tilted like a capsizing ship.
sentences.zh: 巨大的头部像一艘倾覆的船一样歪着。

sentences.en: His big front horn was blunt, scarred, worn.
sentences.zh: 它巨大的前角已经变钝、布满伤痕、磨损严重。

sentences.en: His breathing was harsh and ragged.
sentences.zh: 它的呼吸粗重而沙哑。

sentences.en: All around him, for miles in every direction, the savannah teemed with life.
sentences.zh: 在它周围，方圆数英里内，热带草原上生机勃勃。

sentences.en: Warthogs, zebras, elephants, giraffes, leopards, lions, baboons, creatures doing what they had been doing for eons.
sentences.zh: 疣猪、斑马、大象、长颈鹿、豹子、狮子、狒狒，各种生物都在做着它们亿万年来一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: Hunting and feeding and scavenging.
sentences.zh: 狩猎、觅食和食腐。

sentences.en: Breathing and going and being.
sentences.zh: 呼吸着，前行着，存在着。

sentences.en: Until recently, Sudan had been a part of this pulse.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，苏丹还是这脉搏的一部分。

sentences.en: But now, he could hardly move.
sentences.zh: 但现在，它几乎动弹不得。

sentences.en: He was a giant stillness at the center of all the motion.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些运动的中心，它是一尊巨大的静止雕像。

sentences.en: Sudan was the last male northern white rhinoceros on Earth.
sentences.zh: 苏丹是地球上最后一头雄性北方白犀牛。

sentences.en: The end of an evolutionary rope that stretched back millions of years.
sentences.zh: 一条绵延数百万年的进化之绳的终点。

sentences.en: Although his death was a disaster, it was not a surprise.
sentences.zh: 尽管它的死是一场灾难，但这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: It was the grim climax of a conservation crisis that had been accelerating for many decades toward precisely this moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一场几十年来一直在加速、并精准走向这一刻的保护危机的严峻高潮。

sentences.en: Every desperate measure, legal, political, scientific, had already been exhausted.
sentences.zh: 所有绝望的措施——法律的、政治的、科学的——都已经用尽了。

sentences.en: Sudan was 45 years old, ancient for a rhino.
sentences.zh: 苏丹已经 45 岁了，对于犀牛来说已是高龄。

sentences.en: His skin was creased all over.
sentences.zh: 它的全身都布满了褶皱。

sentences.en: Wrinkles radiated out from his eyes.
sentences.zh: 皱纹从它的眼睛周围放射状散开。

sentences.en: He was gray, the color of stone.
sentences.zh: 它是灰色的，石头般的颜色。

sentences.en: He looked like a boulder that breathed.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像一块会呼吸的巨石。

sentences.en: For months now, his body had been failing.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，它的身体一直在垮掉。

sentences.en: When he walked, his toes scraped the ground.
sentences.zh: 它走路时，脚趾刮着地面。

sentences.en: His legs were covered with sores.
sentences.zh: 它的腿上布满了溃疡。

sentences.en: One deep gash had become badly infected.
sentences.zh: 一道深深的伤口已经严重感染。

sentences.en: The previous day, shortly before sunset, he collapsed for the final time.
sentences.zh: 前一天日落前不久，它最后一次瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: He struggled at first to stand back up.
sentences.zh: 起初它挣扎着想要站起来。

sentences.en: His caretakers crouched and heaved, trying to help.
sentences.zh: 它的饲养员们蹲下来使劲抬，试图帮忙。

sentences.en: But his legs were too weak.
sentences.zh: 但它的腿太虚弱了。

sentences.en: The men fed him bananas stuffed with pain pills,
sentences.zh: 男人们给它喂塞了止痛药的香蕉，

sentences.en: 24 pills at a time.
sentences.zh: 一次 24 片药。

sentences.en: Veterinarians packed his wounds with medical clay.
sentences.zh: 兽医们用医用黏土填满它的伤口。

sentences.en: In the last years of his life, Sudan had become a global celebrity, a conservation icon.
sentences.zh: 在其生命的最后几年里，苏丹已经成为了全球名人和保护偶像。

sentences.en: He lived like an ex-president under the protection of 24-7 armed guards.
sentences.zh: 它像前总统一样生活在全天候武装警卫的保护之下。

sentences.en: Visitors traveled from everywhere to see him.
sentences.zh: 游客们从各地赶来见它。

sentences.en: Sudan was a perfect ambassador.
sentences.zh: 苏丹是一个完美的使者。

sentences.en: He weighed more than two tons, but had the personality of a golden retriever.
sentences.zh: 它重达两吨多，但却有着金毛寻回犬的性格。

sentences.en: He would let people touch him and feed him snacks.
sentences.zh: 它会让人抚摸它并给它喂零食。

sentences.en: A whole carrot clamped in his big boxy mouth looked like a little orange toothpick.
sentences.zh: 一整根胡萝卜塞在它那硕大的方形嘴里，看起来就像一根小小的橙色牙签。

sentences.en: Tourists got emotional, because they knew they were laying hands on a singular creature, a primordial giant about to slide off into the void.
sentences.zh: 游客们情绪激动，因为他们知道自己正在触摸一个独一无二的生物，一个即将滑入虚无的太古巨兽。

sentences.en: Many hurried back to their cars and cried.
sentences.zh: 许多人匆忙跑回车里哭泣。

sentences.en: Although Sudan was the last male, he was not actually the last of his kind.
sentences.zh: 尽管苏丹是最后一头雄性，但它其实并不是同类的最后一只。

sentences.en: He still had two living descendants, both female.
sentences.zh: 它还有两个活着的后代，都是雌性。

sentences.en: Najin, a daughter, and Fatu, a granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 女儿纳金，以及孙女法图。

sentences.en: As Sudan declined, these two stood grazing in a nearby field.
sentences.zh: 随着苏丹身体状况的恶化，这两只犀牛一直在附近的草地上吃草。

sentences.en: They would live out their days in a strange existential twilight, a state of limbo that scientists call, with heartbreaking dryness, functional extinction.
sentences.zh: 它们将在一种奇怪的存在主义暮色中度过余生，这是一种科学家们以令人心碎的枯燥语气称之为功能性灭绝的边缘状态。

sentences.en: Their subspecies was no longer viable.
sentences.zh: 它们的亚种已不再具有生存能力。

sentences.en: Two females, all by themselves, would not be able to save it.
sentences.zh: 孤零零的两只雌性，将无法拯救它。

sentences.en: In his final moments, Sudan was surrounded by the men who loved him.
sentences.zh: 在生命的最后时刻，苏丹被爱它的男人们包围着。

sentences.en: His caretakers were veterans of the deep bush, not on any level strangers to death.
sentences.zh: 它的饲养员都是深林中的老兵，对死亡绝不陌生。

sentences.en: They had survived close encounters with lions and elephants and buffalo and baboons.
sentences.zh: 它们曾在与狮子、大象、水牛和狒狒的近距离接触中幸存下来。

sentences.en: But this was something new.
sentences.zh: 但这是前所未有的。

sentences.en: We expect extinction to unfold offstage, in the mists of prehistory, not right in front of our faces, on a specific calendar day.
sentences.zh: 我们预期灭绝会在后台上演，在史前迷雾中，而不是就在我们眼前，在某个特定的日历日。

sentences.en: And yet here it was, March 19, 2018.
sentences.zh: 然而它就在这里，2018 年 3 月 19 日。

sentences.en: The men scratched Sudan's rough skin,
sentences.zh: 男人们抚摸着苏丹粗糙的皮肤，

sentences.en: Sudan, said goodbye, made promises, apologized for the sins of humanity.
sentences.zh: 苏丹，道别，许下承诺，为人类的罪孽道歉。

sentences.en: Finally, the veterinarians euthanized him.
sentences.zh: 最后，兽医对其实施了安乐死。

sentences.en: For a short time, he breathed heavily, and then he died.
sentences.zh: 在短暂的时间里，它沉重地呼吸着，然后死去了。

sentences.en: The men cried.
sentences.zh: 男人们哭了。

sentences.en: But there was also work to be done.
sentences.zh: 但还有工作要做。

sentences.en: Scientists extracted what little sperm Sudan had left, packed it in a cooler, and rushed it off to a lab.
sentences.zh: 科学家们提取了苏丹仅存的一点精子，把它装进保温箱，急忙送往实验室。

sentences.en: Right there in his pen, a team removed Sudan's skin in big sheets.
sentences.zh: 就在它的围栏里，一个团队把苏丹的皮肤大块大块地剥了下来。

sentences.en: The caretakers boiled his bones in a vat.
sentences.zh: 饲养员们在大缸里煮它的骨头。

sentences.en: They were preparing a gift for the distant future.
sentences.zh: 他们在为遥远的未来准备一件礼物。

sentences.en: Someday, Sudan would be reassembled in a museum, like a dodo, or a great auk, or a tyrannosaurus rex.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，苏丹会在博物馆里被重新组装起来，就像渡渡鸟、大海雀或霸王龙一样。

sentences.en: And children would learn that once there had been a thing called a northern white rhinoceros.
sentences.zh: 孩子们会了解到，曾经有一种东西叫做北方白犀牛。

sentences.en: Living creatures would look at the dead one and try to imagine it alive.
sentences.zh: 活着的生物会看着死去的那只，并试图想象它活着的样子。

sentences.en: But they wouldn't be able to, not really.
sentences.zh: 但它们做不到，不可能真正做到。

sentences.en: We can never reconstruct all the odd little moments, boring and thrilling, that make a creature a creature, that make life, life.
sentences.zh: 我们永远无法重构所有那些奇怪的、或无聊或刺激的微小瞬间，正是这些造就了一个生物之生物，造就了生命之生命。

sentences.en: Sudan's death inspired a media frenzy.
sentences.zh: 苏丹的死引发了一场媒体狂热。

sentences.en: A photo of him being caressed by one of his caretakers went viral, collecting millions of likes on social media.
sentences.zh: 一张它被饲养员抚摸的照片在网上疯传，在社交媒体上收获了数百万个赞。

sentences.en: The rhino area was overrun.
sentences.zh: 犀牛区人满为患。

sentences.en: And then, inevitably, the world's attention moved on.
sentences.zh: 然后，不可避免地，世界的注意力转移了。

sentences.en: In May 2019, just over a year after the death of Sudan, the United Nations issued an apocalyptic report about mass extinction.
sentences.zh: 2019 年 5 月，在苏丹死后刚过一年多，联合国发布了一份关于大众灭绝的末日般报告。

sentences.en: One million plant and animal species, it warned, were at risk of annihilation.
sentences.zh: 报告警告称，有一百万种动植物物种面临灭绝的危险。

sentences.en: This obviously was a horror.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一场恐怖。

sentences.en: Mass extinction is the ultimate crisis, doom of all dooms, the disaster toward which all other disasters flow.
sentences.zh: 大众灭绝是终极危机，是末日中的末日，是所有其他灾难汇聚而成的灾难。

sentences.en: What could humans do that would be worse than killing the life all around us, irreversibly at scale?
sentences.zh: 人类究竟能做出什么事，比在全世界范围内不可逆转地大面积灭绝生命还要糟糕？

sentences.en: One million species.
sentences.zh: 一百万个物种。

sentences.en: A number so large exceeds the mind.
sentences.zh: 如此庞大的数字超出了人类的想象极限。

sentences.en: It becomes, as Albert Camus puts it in The Plague, a puff of smoke in the imagination.
sentences.zh: 正如阿尔贝·加缪在《鼠疫》中所说，它在想象中不过是一缕青烟。

sentences.en: And yet we cannot allow ourselves to forget the reality concealed by that puff of smoke.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们不能让自己忘记那缕青烟所掩盖的现实。

sentences.en: One million is not just a number.
sentences.zh: 一百万不仅仅是一个数字。

sentences.en: It contains countless living creatures.
sentences.zh: 它包含着无数的生灵。

sentences.en: Individual frogs, bats, turtles, tigers, bees, eels, puffins, owls.
sentences.zh: 一只只青蛙、蝙蝠、海龟、老虎、蜜蜂、鳗鱼、海鹦、猫头鹰。

sentences.en: Each one as real as you or me.
sentences.zh: 每一个都和你我一样真实。

sentences.en: Each with its own life story and family ties and collection of habits.
sentences.zh: 每一个都有自己的生命故事、家庭纽带和生活习性。

sentences.en: Together, these animals make up a vast, incredible archive.
sentences.zh: 这些动物共同构成了一个庞大而不可思议的档案库。

sentences.en: A collection of evolutionary stories so rich and complex that our highly evolved brains can hardly begin to hold them.
sentences.zh: 这是一部如此丰富和复杂的演化史诗，以至于我们高度进化的的大脑几乎难以承载。

sentences.en: Modern humans, for no good reason, have lit that archive on fire.
sentences.zh: 现代人类却毫无正当理由地把这座档案库付之一炬。

sentences.en: We are destroying the Vaquita, a tiny porpoise that glides around in the Gulf of California.
sentences.zh: 我们正在灭绝小头鼠海豚，一种在加利福尼亚湾四处游弋的微型鼠海豚。

sentences.en: The Christmas Island Shrew, which scurries, or scurried, there may be none left, through rainforests on a speck of land out in the middle of the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 圣诞岛鼩，它曾在印度洋中央一小块陆地的热带雨林中穿梭——或者说曾经穿梭，现在可能已经无一存活。

sentences.en: And of course, the northern white rhinoceros.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有北方白犀牛。

sentences.en: The evolutionary story of the rhinoceros stretches back roughly 55 million years, to an alien epoch when Europe was a cluster of tropical islands, when cat-sized horses galloped
sentences.zh: 犀牛的演化史可以追溯到大约5500万年前的一个陌生时代，那时欧洲还是一群热带岛屿，猫一般大小的马儿奔跑在

sentences.en: across North America, when wolf-like carnivores were just beginning to wade into the ocean to start the very strange process of turning into whales.
sentences.zh: 北美洲大地上，犬齿状的食肉动物才刚刚开始涉足海洋，开启它们转变成鲸鱼的奇妙历程。

sentences.en: All over the planet, mammals were feeling out what it meant to be mammals, groping toward their best forMs. Some early kinds of rhinos looked like hippos or tapirs.
sentences.zh: 在地球的各个角落，哺乳动物们正在摸索作为哺乳动物的意义，向着它们最佳的形态摸索前行。某些早期犀牛看起来像河马或貘。

sentences.en: One especially huge relative had such a long neck that it is sometimes called the giraffe rhinoceros.
sentences.zh: 其中一个体型尤其巨大的亲戚长着长长的脖子，有时被称为长颈犀牛。

sentences.en: At some point, rumbling across the eons, the rhino settled into the basic form we know today.
sentences.zh: 在漫长岁月的隆隆向前中，犀牛在某个时间点定格成了我们今天所熟知的基本形态。

sentences.en: Massive and thick and front-loaded, with small eyes set behind a menacing horn, often too.
sentences.zh: 庞大、厚重、重心靠前，小小的眼睛长在具有威慑力的角后面，而且往往也很大。

sentences.en: Although rhinos look dangerous, their life mission has always been peaceful, to munch on plants and reproduce.
sentences.zh: 尽管犀牛看起来很危险，但它们一生的使命一直是和平的，那就是啃食植物和繁衍后代。

sentences.en: For millions of years, rhinos fulfilled their goals with great success.
sentences.zh: 数百万年来，犀牛以巨大的成功实现了它们的目标。

sentences.en: Without many predators, without any prey, they flourished across Asia and North America, Africa, and Europe.
sentences.zh: 在没有太多捕食者、也没有固定猎物的情况下，它们在亚洲、北美洲、非洲和欧洲繁衍生息。

sentences.en: Humans put an end to that.
sentences.zh: 人类亲手终结了这一切。

sentences.en: With primitive weapons, we hunted the rhinoceros.
sentences.zh: 我们用原始的武器猎杀犀牛。

sentences.en: Over time, those weapons grew so strong that the rhino's natural armor stood no chance.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这些武器变得如此强大，以至于犀牛天然的盔甲根本不堪一击。

sentences.en: The very assets that made them prehistorically indestructible, size, horns, turned out to be liabilities.
sentences.zh: 正是那些让它们在史前时代所向披靡的特质——体型和犀角——最终成了它们的致命弱点。

sentences.en: Size made rhinos easy targets.
sentences.zh: 巨大的体型让犀牛成了显眼的目标。

sentences.en: Horns were coveted for all kinds of reasons, as trophies, as tools reputed to detect poison and ease childbirth, as the raw material for decorative Yemeni dagger handles.
sentences.zh: 犀角因各种原因而备受追捧：作为战利品，作为据说能解毒和催生的工具，作为装饰性也门匕首柄的原材料。

sentences.en: And perhaps most notorious, as an ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine, whose practitioners believe that powdered rhino horn can perform a long list of marvels.
sentences.zh: 或许最臭名昭著的是，它被用作中药成分，中医从业者相信犀牛角粉能够发挥一长串神奇的功效。

sentences.en: It can cool the blood, ease headaches, stop vomiting, cure snake bites, and much more.
sentences.zh: 它能凉血、缓解头痛、止呕、治蛇毒等等。

sentences.en: Alongside the acute violence of hunting, there is the chronic violence of habitat loss.
sentences.zh: 伴随着捕杀的剧烈暴力，还有栖息地丧失的慢性暴力。

sentences.en: Strip malls, soccer fields, farms, highways, factories.
sentences.zh: 露天购物中心、足球场、农场、高速公路、工厂。

sentences.en: These, too, are weapons.
sentences.zh: 这些同样也是武器。

sentences.en: Big wild animals need big wild spaces, and modern humanity has left almost nothing untouched.
sentences.zh: 大型野生动物需要广阔的野生空间，而现代人类几乎没有留下任何未被触及的净土。

sentences.en: This has resulted in almost unfathomable loss, a holocaust of rhinos.
sentences.zh: 这导致了几乎无法估量的损失，堪称犀牛的大浩劫。

sentences.en: The Javan rhinoceros, which once roamed all over
sentences.zh: 爪哇犀曾经在整个

sentences.en: Southeast Asia, is now confined to a single national park in Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 东南亚到处漫步，如今却局限于印度尼西亚的一个国家公园里。

sentences.en: Its tiny population, 74, concentrated so dangerously that conservationists worry it could be wiped out by the eruption of a nearby volcano.
sentences.zh: 其仅存的74只的数量高度集中，以至于自然保护主义者担心它可能会被附近火山的爆发彻底消灭。

sentences.en: The Sumatran rhino, a small, hairy, adorable loner, is in a similarly poor state.
sentences.zh: 苏门答腊犀是一种体型小巧、毛茸茸、讨人喜欢的独行者，其现状同样糟糕。

sentences.en: Today, there are fewer than 80.
sentences.zh: 如今，它们的数量已经不足80只。

sentences.en: No rhino, however, is doing worse than the northern white.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有任何一种犀牛的处境比北方白犀牛更糟了。

sentences.en: Its native habitat in Central
sentences.zh: 它在中非的

sentences.en: Africa was roiled by civil wars in the late 20th century, making conservation basically impossible.
sentences.zh: 原生栖息地在20世纪后期被内战搅得天翻地覆，这使得保护工作基本成为不可能。

sentences.en: By the 1970s, a population of thousands was reduced to just 700.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪70年代，数千头的种群数量锐减至仅仅700头。

sentences.en: By the mid-1980s, only 15 northern whites remained in the wild.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪80年代中期，野外仅存15头北方白犀牛。

sentences.en: By 2006, that number was four.
sentences.zh: 到了2006年，这个数字变成了4头。

sentences.en: And then they seemed to have disappeared by 2008, almost certainly the victims of poachers.
sentences.zh: 随后它们似乎在2008年消失了，几乎可以肯定是偷猎者的受害者。

sentences.en: The northern white rhinoceros had been eliminated from its native range.
sentences.zh: 北方白犀牛已经在其原生分布区绝迹。

sentences.en: Fortunately, there was a backup plan.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，还有一个备用计划。

sentences.en: In the 1970s, a small reserve supply of northern whites had been captured and relocated to a zoo as a kind of biological life insurance policy.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代，一小批被捕获的北方白犀牛储备被转移到了动物园，作为一种生物人寿保险。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, these animals were dying off faster than they could reproduce.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这些动物死亡的速度比它们繁殖的速度还要快。

sentences.en: In 2009, the only remaining eligible breeders, Sudan and Sunni, and Najin and Fatou, were brought back to Africa to a wildlife conservancy in Kenya.
sentences.zh: 2009年，仅存的几头符合繁殖条件的犀牛苏丹、苏尼、纳金和法图被带回非洲，来到了肯尼亚的一个野生动物保护区。

sentences.en: It was a moonshot, a hope that their native continent might stir something deep in the biology of the final four, that it might produce a miracle.
sentences.zh: 这是一次孤注一掷的尝试，人们希望它们的本土能唤醒最后四头犀牛生物学深处某种沉睡的东西，期盼能出现奇迹。

sentences.en: Alas, it did not.
sentences.zh: 可惜，奇迹并没有发生。

sentences.en: Sunni died, then Sudan.
sentences.zh: 苏尼死了，接着苏丹也死了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, there were only two northern whites left.
sentences.zh: 转眼间，世界上只剩下两头北方白犀牛了。

sentences.en: They were still out there in the field, doing the things their ancestors had always done, eating grass, wallowing in mud holes, taking naps in the shade of trees.
sentences.zh: 它们依然在野外游荡，做着祖先们一直在做的事情：吃草、在泥坑里打滚、在树荫下小憩。

sentences.en: But now everything was different.
sentences.zh: 但现在一切都变了。

sentences.en: They lumbered around in a world between life and death, both here and not here.
sentences.zh: 它们在生死之间的世界里踯躅前行，亦此亦彼，忽即忽离。

sentences.en: Every mouthful of grass they ate was one mouthful closer to the last that would ever be eaten.
sentences.zh: 它们嚼下的每一口草，都让它们向着有生以来吃下的最后一口草更近了一步。

sentences.en: After Sudan died, I could not stop thinking about the last two.
sentences.zh: 苏丹死后，我脑海里总是挥之不去最后这两头犀牛的身影。

sentences.en: What were they like?
sentences.zh: 它们是什么样子的？

sentences.en: What did they do all day?
sentences.zh: 它们整天都在做些什么？

sentences.en: I found their existence strangely cheering.
sentences.zh: 我发现它们的存活带有一种奇异的鼓舞人心的力量。

sentences.en: Although their story was almost unbearably tragic, they themselves were not tragic.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们的故事悲惨得令人几乎无法承受，但它们自身并不悲惨。

sentences.en: They were just rhinos.
sentences.zh: 它们只是犀牛。

sentences.en: To meet them would be a chance to look mass extinction in the face.
sentences.zh: 与它们相遇将是一个直面大规模物种灭绝的机会。

sentences.en: On the long flight from New York to Kenya, I spent my time reading about northern white rhinos.
sentences.zh: 从纽约飞往肯尼亚的漫长航程中，我一直在阅读有关北方白犀牛的书籍。

sentences.en: They are not actually white.
sentences.zh: 它们其实并不是白色的。

sentences.en: Their name most likely was a colonialist misunderstanding.
sentences.zh: 它们的名字很可能是殖民者产生的一场误解。

sentences.en: Dutch settlers called them veit, meaning wide.
sentences.zh: 荷兰定居者称它们为“veit”，意思是宽。

sentences.en: And English settlers thought they were saying white.
sentences.zh: 而英国定居者以为他们说的是“white”（白）。

sentences.en: And then they compounded the error by calling Africa's other species of rhino black.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又错上加错，把非洲的另一种犀牛称为黑犀牛。

sentences.en: But it's all just total nonsense, because both, in reality, are classic rhinoceros gray.
sentences.zh: 但这一切完全是胡说八道，因为实际上这两种犀牛都是经典的犀牛灰。

sentences.en: In Nairobi, I boarded a little bush plane that rumbled like a flying bus up toward the countryside.
sentences.zh: 在内罗毕，我登上了一架小型丛林飞机，它像一辆会飞的公交车一样轰鸣着飞向乡村。

sentences.en: As I flew, I stared for the ten millionth time at photos of the last two survivors.
sentences.zh: 飞行途中，我第千万次凝视着最后两头幸存者的照片。

sentences.en: They were not originally from Kenya.
sentences.zh: 它们并非土生土长的肯尼亚动物。

sentences.en: No northern white rhino ever was.
sentences.zh: 没有一头北方白犀牛原本属于这里。

sentences.en: But this is where they ended up, on a former cattle ranch that was now a wildlife conservancy called Olpegeta, which had had success breeding rhinos.
sentences.zh: 但它们最终来到了这里，在一个名为奥尔佩杰塔（Olpegeta）的、曾成功繁育犀牛的前养牛场兼野生动物保护区安家。

sentences.en: A big rattling truck carried me into the conservancy, down dirt roads past zebras and
sentences.zh: 一辆颠簸的大卡车把我载进保护区，沿着泥土路驶过斑马、

sentences.en: warthogs and a glowering thick-horned cape buffalo, past an official sign that marked the equator, into Olpegeta's rhino area.
sentences.zh: 疣猪和一头面目狰狞、长着粗角的非洲水牛，穿过标志着赤道的官方路标，进入了奥尔佩杰塔的犀牛区。

sentences.en: Finally, after all those months of reading and imagining, I found myself out in the field.
sentences.zh: 终于，经历了数月的阅读和想象后，我身处这片旷野之中。

sentences.en: And there they were in the distance, grazing.
sentences.zh: 它们就在远处悠闲地吃着草。

sentences.en: The last two northern whites, the real creatures.
sentences.zh: 最后两头北方白犀牛，真实的生灵。

sentences.en: They stood together on a wide, flat stretch of tussocky grasses, heads lowered to the ground, and against the horizon they looked like parts of the landscape,
sentences.zh: 它们并肩站在一大片长满丛生草的开阔平地上，头低垂向地面，在天际线的衬托下，它们看起来就像风景的一部分，

sentences.en: like geological deposits.
sentences.zh: 就像地质沉积物一样。

sentences.en: Comical flocks of guinea fowls scampered back and forth, twittering.
sentences.zh: 一群滑稽的珠鸡叽叽喳喳地跑来跑去。

sentences.en: One of the rhino caretakers brought out a large white bucket, and swinging it, scattered treats in piles near our feet, carrots, horse pellets.
sentences.zh: 一名犀牛饲养员拿出一个大白桶，一边晃动一边把胡萝卜、马饲料等零食撒在我们脚边的草地上。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the rhinos were in motion, padding over, looking simultaneously clumsy and graceful, bulky but gliding, their skin folds
sentences.zh: 瞬间，犀牛动了起来，小跑着走过来，看起来既笨拙又优雅，体态臃肿却又步履轻盈，它们皮肤上的皱褶

sentences.en: bouncing, huge snouts wiggling to the rhythm of their clomping steps.
sentences.zh: 随之弹动，巨大的口鼻部随着沉重的步伐节奏上下耸动。

sentences.en: Just like that, my imagination was overridden by their reality.
sentences.zh: 就这样，我的想象被它们的现实所取代。

sentences.en: The animals approaching became the animals.
sentences.zh: 走近的动物变成了活生生的动物。

sentences.en: None of my preparation really prepared me for being in their presence.
sentences.zh: 我所做的所有准备，其实都没有让我真正做好与它们共处一室的心理准备。

sentences.en: To stand near them is to feel things.
sentences.zh: 站在它们身旁，能真切地感受到许多东西。

sentences.en: It is to feel, first of all, size, the blunt, creaturely meaning of it.
sentences.zh: 首先感受到的就是体型，一种直白而充满生灵气息的体型震撼。

sentences.en: White rhinos are the second-largest land mammals, second only to elephants.
sentences.zh: 白犀牛是仅次于大象的第二大陆生哺乳动物。

sentences.en: They can grow to be 6,000 pounds, with a curved front horn up to five feet long.
sentences.zh: 它们的体重可达6000磅（约2.7吨），长着长达五英尺的弯曲前角。

sentences.en: To stand near something so huge tugs on the gravity of your cells.
sentences.zh: 站在如此庞大的庞然大物身旁，你会感受到一种牵引你细胞的重力。

sentences.en: You feel present and embodied, being dwarfed by these warm-blooded munchers.
sentences.zh: 被这些温血的食草动物衬托得如此渺小，你会感到当下极其真实且充满生命的质感。

sentences.en: I was allowed to stand very close, close enough to hear their huffing breath, to see them blink
sentences.zh: 我被允许站在非常近的地方，近到能听到它们粗重的呼吸声，看到它们眨动

sentences.en: their big mild eyes, to see that their ears were fringed with a rim of hairs that seemed as delicate as eyelashes, that their tails had little black tufts.
sentences.zh: 它们那巨大温和的眼睛，看到它们的耳缘长着一圈纤细得如同睫毛般的细毛，它们的尾巴上还带着一小撮黑色的毛球。

sentences.en: Their horns up close were ragged, with scraggly, fibrous patches, like shafts of splintering wood.
sentences.zh: 近看它们的角是粗糙的，带有参差不齐的纤维状斑块，就像一根根劈裂的木桩。

sentences.en: I watched them press their great wrinkled mouths against the ground, snuffling and chomping.
sentences.zh: 我看着它们将巨大褶皱的嘴贴在地面上，嗅闻并咀嚼着。

sentences.en: Sometimes they looked up at me, expressionless.
sentences.zh: 有时它们会面无表情地抬起头看着我。

sentences.en: White rhinos are sometimes called square-mouthed rhinos, and up close I could see why.
sentences.zh: 白犀牛有时被称为方嘴犀牛，近距离观察后我明白了原因。

sentences.en: Their lips pressed together in a long, flat line, giving them a constant expression of slightly comic seriousness, like the classic straight-faced emoji.
sentences.zh: 它们的嘴唇紧闭成一条长而平直的线，使它们始终带着一种略带滑稽的严肃表情，就像经典的面无表情的表情符号一样。

sentences.en: At one point, Fatu, the daughter, following a seam of fresh grass, ended up grazing right next to me.
sentences.zh: 有一次，女儿法图顺着一片鲜嫩的草迹，竟然一路吃草吃到了我身边。

sentences.en: She stood so close I could study her skin, which was scored with intricate patterns, deep cracks and lines that made me think of tree bark.
sentences.zh: 她站得如此之近，以至于我可以仔细观察她的皮肤，上面布满了复杂的纹理、深深的裂纹和线条，让我想起了树皮。

sentences.en: It looked in some places like impenetrable armor, but also in others, soft.
sentences.zh: 它在某些地方看起来像坚不可摧的盔甲，但在另一些地方又显得十分柔软。

sentences.en: It folded over on itself, around the neck and the legs, with a luxurious fluidity of molten lava or hot fudge in an ice cream ad.
sentences.zh: 皮肤在颈部和腿部层层叠叠地褶皱着，带着一种冰淇淋广告中融化的岩浆或热巧克力酱般奢华的流淌感。

sentences.en: She was so close that, with permission, I reached out and touched her.
sentences.zh: 她离得如此之近，以至于在征得许可后，我伸出手抚摸了她。

sentences.en: Again, everything was different from what I had imagined.
sentences.zh: 同样，一切都与我想象的截然不同。

sentences.en: Her skin was not smooth, but rough, dry, scratchy.
sentences.zh: 她的皮肤并不光滑，而是粗糙、干燥且扎手。

sentences.en: Eventually, I had to leave, and back in my tent for the night, I spent all my time reliving
sentences.zh: 最终我不得不离开，当晚回到帐篷里，我把所有时间都用来重温在野外度过的那些时刻，

sentences.en: those moments in the field, staring at photos and videos, trying to summon the solidity of being with them, and above all, waiting for the sun to rise so I could go back.
sentences.zh: 凝视着照片和视频，试图唤起与它们相伴时的踏实感，最重要的是，期盼着太阳升起好让我能再次回去。

sentences.en: In 2009, when Najin and Fatu first came to Africa, they were scared of everything.
sentences.zh: 2009年纳金和法图刚来到非洲时，它们对什么都感到害怕。

sentences.en: They would flinch whenever the wind blew, jump away from every rabbit that hopped out of a bush.
sentences.zh: 风一吹它们就会畏缩，草丛里跳出一只兔子它们也会吓得跳开。

sentences.en: They were born and raised in a zoo.
sentences.zh: 它们是在动物园里出生和长大的。

sentences.en: Their births, in 1989 and 2000, were two of the very few bright spots in the otherwise doomed international project to save the northern whites.
sentences.zh: 它们分别于1989年和2000年出生，这是拯救北方白犀牛这一注定失败的国际项目中极少数的亮点之一。

sentences.en: Although their ancestors were from Africa, these particular creatures were not.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们的祖先来自非洲，但这特定的两头动物并非如此。

sentences.en: They grew up in the Czech Republic, in man-made enclosures, eating pre-cut grasses, surrounded by humans.
sentences.zh: 它们在捷克共和国长大，生活在人造围栏里，吃着切好的草，身边环绕着人类。

sentences.en: They had no idea how to be wild rhinos.
sentences.zh: 它们根本不知道如何当一头野生犀牛。

sentences.en: So Ulpajeta brought in a tutor, a wild southern white rhino named Tawu.
sentences.zh: 于是奥尔佩杰塔请来了一位导师，一头名叫陶（Tawu）的野生南方白犀牛。

sentences.en: The southern white subspecies is a close relative of the northern.
sentences.zh: 南方白犀牛亚种是北方白犀牛的近亲。

sentences.en: Once upon a time, there was just one big white rhino population stretching across Africa.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，非洲大陆上只有一个庞大的白犀牛种群。

sentences.en: But it was separated, very likely by an ice age, leaving two groups to evolve at a great distance along roughly parallel tracks.
sentences.zh: 但它们被分隔开来，极有可能是因为冰河时期，导致两群犀牛在相距甚远的大致平行轨道上各自演化。

sentences.en: Teddy Roosevelt, rhino enthusiast, put it nicely.
sentences.zh: 犀牛狂热爱好者西奥多·罗斯福对此有过精妙的描述。

sentences.en: It is almost as if our bison had never been known within historic times except in Texas and
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像我们的美洲野牛在历史上除了得克萨斯和

sentences.en: Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔之外，鲜为人知一样。

sentences.en: Over time, the isolated populations developed into two distinct subspecies.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这些被隔离的种群演化成了两个截然不同的亚种。

sentences.en: Northern white rhinos lived on marshy land among tall grasses.
sentences.zh: 北方白犀牛生活在高草丛生的沼泽地带。

sentences.en: They developed wider feet, which some research suggests helped them walk on mud, plus slightly hairier ears.
sentences.zh: 它们演化出了更宽的脚掌，一些研究表明这有助于它们在泥地里行走，此外它们的耳朵也稍微多毛一些。

sentences.en: Southern white rhinos lived in the open savannah.
sentences.zh: 南方白犀牛则生活在开阔的稀树草原上。

sentences.en: Today, the biggest difference between the two is that the southern white rhino population is thriving, at least by rhino standards.
sentences.zh: 如今，两者最大的区别在于，南方白犀牛的种群正在蓬勃发展，至少以犀牛的标准来看是这样的。

sentences.en: After being nearly hunted to extinction in the late 1800s, a series of strict protections managed to bring them back.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪末几乎被猎杀至灭绝之后，一系列严格的保护措施成功让它们恢复了生机。

sentences.en: The southern white rhino is now a great conservation success story.
sentences.zh: 南方白犀牛如今是一个伟大的自然保护成功故事。

sentences.en: Tawu is fast and aggressive, with a horn as sharp as a dragon's tooth.
sentences.zh: 陶动作敏捷且具有攻击性，长着一对如龙牙般锋利的角。

sentences.en: Just by moving into the rhino area and doing her wild rhino things, she taught the northern whites certain basic life skills.
sentences.zh: 仅仅通过搬进犀牛区并表现出她野生犀牛的行为，她就教会了北方白犀牛某些基本的生存技能。

sentences.en: She taught them, for instance, how to sharpen their horns by scraping them back and forth on the metal gates surrounding their enclosure.
sentences.zh: 例如，她教会了它们如何通过在围栏周围的金属大门上来回蹭来磨尖自己的角。

sentences.en: She taught them how to mark their territory by pooping strategically in large piles, before they just went wherever they happened to be standing.
sentences.zh: 她教会了它们如何通过将粪便有策略地堆成大堆来标记领地，而在此之前它们只是随地大小便。

sentences.en: She taught them how to graze, how to find the short soft grass and scythe their heads back and forth to rip it from the ground with their lips.
sentences.zh: 她教会了它们如何吃草，如何寻找矮小柔软的草，并用嘴唇左右挥动头部将草从地上连根扯下。

sentences.en: Above all, Tawu taught the two northern whites not to be afraid of Africa.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，陶教会了两头北方白犀牛不再害怕非洲。

sentences.en: The wind whistling through the acacia trees, the rabbits, the warthogs, the little birds hopping all over their backs and faces.
sentences.zh: 吹过相思树的微风、兔子、疣猪、在它们的背上和脸上跳来跳去的小鸟。

sentences.en: Today, the northern white rhinos seem perfectly at home in
sentences.zh: 如今，北方白犀牛在

sentences.en: Olpegeta, where everyone refers to them affectionately as the girls.
sentences.zh: 奥尔佩杰塔显得十分自在，每个人都亲切地称呼它们为“女孩们”。

sentences.en: They live in a state of supervised wildness, with a daily routine full of little rituals and pleasures.
sentences.zh: 它们生活在一种受监督的野生状态中，日常生活中充满了各种小仪式和乐趣。

sentences.en: At dawn, the caretakers come clanking in through a series of gates, and the girls pad out of their pens to greet them.
sentences.zh: 黎明时分，饲养员们叮叮当当地穿过重重铁门走进来，女孩们便慢跑着走出栏舍去迎接他们。

sentences.en: Rhinos have fairly weak eyes, but their noses and ears are powerful, and the girls can identify the men by scent and sound.
sentences.zh: 犀牛的视力相当弱，但它们的嗅觉和听觉很灵敏，而且母犀牛能通过气味和声音辨别男性。

sentences.en: White rhinos are surprisingly relaxed.
sentences.zh: 白犀牛出奇地放松。

sentences.en: They could kill you if necessary, but they would prefer not to.
sentences.zh: 必要时它们能置你于死地，但它们并不想这么做。

sentences.en: As Martin Booth, an English writer who spent part of his childhood in East Africa put it, whenever one sees a white rhino in the wild, one cannot escape the
sentences.zh: 正如英国作家马丁·布思所说，他童年的一部分时间是在东非度过的，每当人们在野外看到一只白犀牛，就无法摆脱一种

sentences.en: impression of size, of incredible benign strength, and of a strange inner passiveness.
sentences.zh: 巨大、不可思议的温和力量，以及一种奇怪的内在平静的印象。

sentences.en: The creature looks peaceful, amiable, and secure.
sentences.zh: 这种生物看起来平静、温和而安全。

sentences.en: If a creature can be said to have discovered transcendental meditation, then it must be the white rhino.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么生物可以被称为发现了超觉静坐，那一定就是白犀牛。

sentences.en: The girls, having grown up in a zoo, are especially good-natured.
sentences.zh: 这两只母犀牛在动物园长大，性格人格外温顺。

sentences.en: Their morning often starts with a thorough scratchdown from one of the caretakers, an affectionate check-in.
sentences.zh: 它们的早晨通常是从饲养员的一次全身挠痒开始的，这是一种充满爱意的问候。

sentences.en: Now Jean, the older and milder of the two, particularly enjoys this.
sentences.zh: 现在，两只中年纪较长、脾气也更温和的吉恩特别享受这一点。

sentences.en: She will walk over and wait for it, then lean her big body in, exhaling softly from her nostrils as the caretaker rubs her forehead, neck, belly, and ears with his hands.
sentences.zh: 她会走过去等待，然后把庞大的身躯靠过来，当饲养员用双手揉搓她的前额、脖子、肚子和耳朵时，她的鼻孔里会轻轻呼出气。

sentences.en: After this, both girls will walk off, under the low orange ball of the dawn sun, to take care of their other duties.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，两只母犀牛会在黎明太阳那低矮的橙色圆球下漫步，去处理它们的其他日常事务。

sentences.en: To wallow in the mud, solemnly sharpen their horns and rub their bodies systematically for minutes at a time against the nub of
sentences.zh: 在泥潭里打滚，庄严地磨砺它们的角，并一次花上几分钟的时间，把身体系统地蹭在

sentences.en: an old wooden fence poSt. To a casual viewer, the girls might look identical.
sentences.zh: 一根旧木栅栏桩上。对于随意的旁观者来说，这两头母犀牛看起来可能一模一样。

sentences.en: Big, gray chunks, always together, always doing more or less the same thing.
sentences.zh: 巨大、灰色的躯块，总是在一起，总是做着差不多同样的事情。

sentences.en: But to their caretakers, they are as distinct as any two family members.
sentences.zh: 但在饲养员眼里，它们和任何两个家庭成员一样独特。

sentences.en: A Jean, the mother, has weak back legs and a distinct line near the end of her front horn, the mark from a saw that was used years ago to trim it.
sentences.zh: 吉恩是母亲，后腿较弱，前角末端附近有一道明显的痕迹，那是多年前用来修剪它的锯子留下的印记。

sentences.en: She is sweet, mellow, gentle, and, at least with her daughter, sometimes strict.
sentences.zh: 她甜美、温和、温柔，而且至少对她的女儿来说，有时很严格。

sentences.en: In every part of the girls' daily routine,
sentences.zh: 在母犀牛日常生活的每个环节中，

sentences.en: Najin leads the way.
sentences.zh: 娜金总是走在最前面。

sentences.en: If Fatou tries to break the hierarchy, to cut in line at the scratching post, or to lie down first for a nap, her mother will restore order with a quick swipe of her horn.
sentences.zh: 如果法图试图打破等级制度，在挠痒处插队，或者第一个躺下来打盹，她的母亲会用角迅速一挥来恢复秩序。

sentences.en: Fatou, who is in her early twenties, still has young energy.
sentences.zh: 法图二十出头，身上仍然有着年轻人的活力。

sentences.en: Rhinos in captivity can live well into their forties.
sentences.zh: 人工饲养的犀牛可以活到四十多岁。

sentences.en: She is curious, unpredictable, sometimes wild.
sentences.zh: 她好奇、不可预测，有时很野性。

sentences.en: The caretakers touch her too, but are a little more careful, a little more attentive to her moods.
sentences.zh: 饲养员也会触摸她，但会更小心一些，对她的情绪也更留心一些。

sentences.en: Fatou has become very close to Tawo.
sentences.zh: 法图和陶沃变得非常亲密。

sentences.en: They graze together, and occasionally, playfully, square off to spar with their horns.
sentences.zh: 它们一起吃草，偶尔也会开玩笑似地摆开架势，用角较量一番。

sentences.en: The humans, meanwhile, give Tawo a very wide berth.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人类对陶沃总是保持着相当大的一段距离。

sentences.en: She has been known to charge with real menace, once forcing a caretaker to save himself by leaping under a truck.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，她曾带着真正的威胁性发起冲锋，有一次迫使一名饲养员跳到卡车底下才得以逃生。

sentences.en: The caretakers are a team of Kenyan men, who wear olive green uniforms and floppy hats, and speak, among them, dozens of languages.
sentences.zh: 这些饲养员是一群肯尼亚男子，他们身穿橄榄绿制服，头戴宽边帽，他们之间交流时会说几十种语言。

sentences.en: Kenya has more than 40 recognized tribes, and around 70 languages, so Kenyans tend to be polyglots.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚有40多个获承认的部族和大约70种语言，因此肯尼亚人往往都是通晓多种语言的人。

sentences.en: The men live in a cluster of simple round huts right next to the girls' enclosure, and they cook themselves modest meals out of modest
sentences.zh: 这些男人们住在紧挨着母犀牛围场的一群简陋圆形小屋里，他们用简单的

sentences.en: rations, and their days are structured around the rhythms of the girls.
sentences.zh: 配给烹调出朴素的饭菜，他们的日子是围绕着母犀牛的节奏来安排的。

sentences.en: They wake at dawn, when the girls wake, and go off duty at sunset, when the girls go into their pens for the night.
sentences.zh: 他们在黎明时分母犀牛醒来时醒来，在日落时分母犀牛回圈过夜时下班。

sentences.en: As a result, the girls and the men are remarkably close.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，母犀牛和男人们的关系异常亲密。

sentences.en: The men spend more time with the girls than they do with their own families, some of whom live far away.
sentences.zh: 男人们花在犀牛身上的时间比陪自己家人（其中有些人的家住得很远）的时间还要多。

sentences.en: With a glance, they can sense the girls' moods and needs.
sentences.zh: 只需一眼，他们就能感知到母犀牛的情绪和需求。

sentences.en: They can stall an angry rhino with a word, or if that doesn't work, by raising a hand, or in truly dire circumstances, by throwing their floppy green hats in the air.
sentences.zh: 他们可以用一句话阻止一头发怒的犀牛，如果这不管用，就举起手，或者在真正危急的情况下，把绿色的宽边帽扔到空中。

sentences.en: They are around the rhinos so much that at night they often dream about them.
sentences.zh: 他们和犀牛在一起的时间太多了，以至于晚上经常梦到它们。

sentences.en: In the dreams, sometimes the rhinos speak.
sentences.zh: 在梦里，有时犀牛会说话。

sentences.en: They give them life advice.
sentences.zh: 它们给他们生活的建议。

sentences.en: Outsiders, me included, tend to have romantic notions of this caretaking job, a sacred guardianship of the rarest animals on earth.
sentences.zh: 外人，包括我在内，往往对这种饲养工作抱有浪漫的想法，认为这是对地球上最稀有动物的神圣守护。

sentences.en: And in environmental circles, the caretakers have become minor celebrities.
sentences.zh: 在环保圈子里，这些饲养员已经成了小有名气的人物。

sentences.en: Joseph Wachira, who goes by Jojo and was featured in that viral photo of the dying Sudan, once met an American woman who had tattooed his name on her arm.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·瓦奇拉，大家都叫他乔乔，曾出现在那张垂死的苏丹的病毒式传播照片中，他曾遇到过一个把他的名字纹在手臂上的美国女人。

sentences.en: The North Carolina Zoo recently named a baby rhino Jojo in his honor.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州动物园最近为了纪念他，将一只小犀牛命名为乔乔。

sentences.en: In Kenya, however, the reality is not glamorous at all.
sentences.zh: 然而在肯尼亚，现实一点也不光鲜亮丽。

sentences.en: The caretakers are poorly paid and sit low in the social hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 饲养员的薪水很低，在社会阶层中处于底层。

sentences.en: Kenyans have a complex relationship to the bush and its animals.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚人与灌木林及其动物有着复杂的关系。

sentences.en: These huge, native, often destructive, but increasingly threatened creatures whose perceived exoticism draws in so much foreign money.
sentences.zh: 这些巨大的、本土的、往往具有破坏性但日益受到威胁的生物，它们身上那种人们眼中的异域风情吸引了大量的外国资金。

sentences.en: Shoveling rhino poop strikes many urban Kenyans as menial and retrograde and slightly embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 在许多城市肯尼亚人看来，铲犀牛便便是一件卑微、落后且略显尴尬的事。

sentences.en: When the caretakers travel outside Olpejeta to go into town, they never wear their green uniforMs. I spent much of my time with one of the younger caretakers, James Mwenda.
sentences.zh: 当饲养员离开奥佩杰塔去镇上时，他们从不穿绿色的制服。我花了很多时间和一个年轻的饲养员詹姆斯·姆温达在一起。

sentences.en: At 31, he is the same age as Najin.
sentences.zh: 31岁的他与娜金同岁。

sentences.en: Mwenda grew up in a poor village at the foot of Mount Kenya, and his dream was to study literature in college.
sentences.zh: 姆温达在肯尼亚山脚下一个贫穷的村庄长大，他的梦想是在大学里学习文学。

sentences.en: When that fell through, he ended up working in the bush with animals.
sentences.zh: 当这个梦想破灭后，他最终来到灌木林里与动物为伍。

sentences.en: At first, it was more of a job than a calling.
sentences.zh: 起初，这更像是一份工作，而不是一种使命。

sentences.en: But soon he fell in love with the northern whites.
sentences.zh: 但很快他就爱上了北方白犀牛。

sentences.en: He speaks to them in a husky, affectionate voice, calling them Mama and Good Girl.
sentences.zh: 他用低沉而充满爱意的声音和它们说话，称呼它们为“妈妈”和“好女孩”。

sentences.en: They follow him around like big, weird dogs.
sentences.zh: 它们像两只体型巨大、奇奇怪怪的狗一样跟在他身后。

sentences.en: When Sudan got sick,
sentences.zh: 当苏丹生病时，

sentences.en: Mwenda felt in a new way, the deep burden of extinction.
sentences.zh: 姆温达以一种崭新的方式感受到了灭绝所带来的沉重负担。

sentences.en: It's emotionally draining, he told me.
sentences.zh: 这在情感上太折磨人了，他告诉我。

sentences.en: I don't like failure.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢失败。

sentences.en: Can you imagine watching a species that is going extinct?
sentences.zh: 你能想象眼睁睁看着一个物种走向灭绝吗？

sentences.en: He promised the dying rhino that he would share the tragedy of the northern whites with the rest of the world,
sentences.zh: 他向垂死的犀牛承诺，他会与世界其他地方分享北方白犀牛的悲剧，

sentences.en: that it would convert that sorrow into an energy that might help rescue other species.
sentences.zh: 要把这份悲伤转化为一种能量，也许能帮助拯救其他物种。

sentences.en: Extinction is a very distant thing for people, Mwenda told me.
sentences.zh: 灭绝离人们非常遥远，姆温达告诉我。

sentences.en: So you have to turn extinction into a story, a story in which people can see themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须把灭绝变成一个故事，一个人们能在其中看到自己的故事。

sentences.en: He does this largely through social media.
sentences.zh: 他主要通过社交媒体来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Out in the field, Mwenda stalks the girls with a fancy long-lensed camera, a gift from a foreign friend.
sentences.zh: 在野外，姆温达带着一台外国朋友送的高档长焦相机跟踪拍摄母犀牛。

sentences.en: Sometimes he will lie in the grass to get interesting angles for his followers.
sentences.zh: 有时他会趴在草地上，为他的粉丝们寻找有趣的角度。

sentences.en: Mwenda recently starred in Kefaru, an American documentary about the northern whites at Olpegeta,
sentences.zh: 姆温达最近主演了《凯法鲁》，这是一部关于奥佩杰塔北方白犀牛的美国纪录片，

sentences.en: and he has traveled from Kenya to give talks in Britain, the United States, and Hong Kong, where he remembers people crying when he showed them photos of rhinos killed by poachers.
sentences.zh: 他曾从肯尼亚出发，前往英国、美国和香港进行演讲，他记得当他向人们展示死于偷猎者的犀牛照片时，人们都哭了。

sentences.en: They had been taught his children that the horns fall off naturally and are collected by rangers.
sentences.zh: 他们以前被教育说，犀牛角是自然脱落的，会被护林员收集起来。

sentences.en: Mwenda would like to change the way people think about African travel, to break the paradigm of tourists staring out of car windows,
sentences.zh: 姆温达希望改变人们对非洲旅行的看法，打破那种游客盯着车窗往外看、

sentences.en: marking animals off of checklists, and moving on.
sentences.zh: 在清单上勾掉动物的名字然后离开的模式。

sentences.en: Why not spend time seeing how they live?
sentences.zh: 为什么不花点时间看看它们是如何生活的呢？

sentences.en: He asked me.
sentences.zh: 他问我。

sentences.en: Spending time helps you connect, just as you would want to spend time with a friend or with a new person, to get to know who they are, how they live, how they do things.
sentences.zh: 花时间有助于建立联系，就像你愿意花时间去了解一个朋友或一个新的人一样，去了解他们是谁，他们如何生活，他们如何做事。

sentences.en: The same thing with these girls.
sentences.zh: 对待这两只母犀牛也是如此。

sentences.en: They're contemporary beings.
sentences.zh: 它们是与我们同时代的生命。

sentences.en: There's a healing aspect to see them as contemporary beings.
sentences.zh: 把它们视为与我们同时代的生命有一种疗愈的作用。

sentences.en: The girls spend their days grazing from dawn to dusk in a 100-acre field.
sentences.zh: 母犀牛们每天从黎明到黄昏在一个占地100英亩的草场上吃草。

sentences.en: It is protected by a tall electric fence, along one side of which runs a road where safari vehicles can stop to look.
sentences.zh: 这里有一道高高的电网保护，电网的一侧是一条道路，供观光车停下来观赏。

sentences.en: Sometimes there are traffic jaMs. Majin and Fathu may not be quite as famous as Sudan, but they are still well-known in safari circles, still bucket-list creatures.
sentences.zh: 有时会有交通堵塞。娜金和法图可能没有苏丹那么有名，但它们在野生动物观赏圈里依然名气很大，依然是人们愿望清单上的生物。

sentences.en: Four times a day, a truckload of visitors who have paid a special fee and signed safety waivers are allowed to come inside the enclosure.
sentences.zh: 一天四次，付过特殊费用并签署了安全免责声明的一车游客被允许进入围场。

sentences.en: The girls surround the truck, eating snacks, while the tourists, Chinese, Australian, German, American, take photos.
sentences.zh: 母犀牛们围着卡车吃零食，而游客们——中国人、澳大利亚人、德国人、美国人——则在一旁拍照。

sentences.en: During the high season, the Rhinos area parking lot fills up with 4x4s and school buses.
sentences.zh: 在旅游旺季，犀牛区的停车场停满了四驱车和校车。

sentences.en: I spent one week out in the field with the girls.
sentences.zh: 我在野外和母犀牛们度过了一个星期。

sentences.en: I would go to them at dawn and leave when the sun set.
sentences.zh: 我黎明时分去找它们，日落时分离开。

sentences.en: It was no time at all in the scheme of things, not even a blink of evolution's eye, and just the tiniest fraction of the girls' big, wrinkled lives.
sentences.zh: 在宏大的时间尺度里，这根本算不上什么，甚至连进化长河中的惊鸿一瞥都算不上，只是母犀牛们巨大而布满皱纹的一生中的极小一部分。

sentences.en: But out there in the field, time hung thick like fog.
sentences.zh: 但在野外的那个地方，时间浓稠得就像雾气一样。

sentences.en: Every day felt like a sliver of eternity.
sentences.zh: 每一天都感觉像是永恒的一小片。

sentences.en: It was the cold season in Kenya, and I stood there through every kind of weather, under orange skies and yellow skies and skies as gray as the girls.
sentences.zh: 那是肯尼亚的寒冷季节，我在各种天气下站在那里，在橙色的天空、黄色的天空以及和母犀牛一样灰暗的天空下。

sentences.en: I watched Fatou get mad at an egret that landed on her back and tried to bucket off.
sentences.zh: 我看着法图对一只落在她背上并试图把它赶走的白鹭生气。

sentences.en: I watched Najin dip her huge head into the water trough and drink so gently, with such delicate sips, that she hardly left a ripple.
sentences.zh: 我看着娜金把她巨大的脑袋浸入水槽，动作轻柔地喝着水，小口小口地抿着，几乎没有激起一丝涟漪。

sentences.en: I watched dung beetles roll perfect spheres of rhino poop, then struggle to wrestle them off to their nest through tall grass.
sentences.zh: 我看着蜣螂滚出完美的犀牛粪球，然后挣扎着穿过高高的草丛把它们推向它们的巢穴。

sentences.en: I watched the girls sharpen their horns clumsily, adorably, on a little metal gate, scraping the paint right off, threatening to tear the whole thing from its hinges.
sentences.zh: 我看着母犀牛们笨拙而又可爱地在一小扇铁门上磨角，把油漆刮得精光，大有一把将整扇门从铰链上扯下来的架势。

sentences.en: I was chased, briefly, by a blind buffalo named Russell.
sentences.zh: 我曾被一头名叫拉塞尔的瞎水牛短暂地追赶过。

sentences.en: I saw Fatou shock herself one morning on the electric fence, right on the face.
sentences.zh: 一天早晨，我看到法图在电网上电了自己，正好电在脸上。

sentences.en: She flinched and raced off, at a speed faster than I knew rhinos could run, and a terrified Najin turned and ran right alongside her.
sentences.zh: 她畏缩了一下并飞奔出去，速度超过了我所知的犀牛奔跑的速度，而惊恐万状的娜金则转身和她并肩奔跑。

sentences.en: During thunderstorms, I stood there getting soaked, watching the girls change color, chocolatey, glistening, as the dust on their backs turned, drop by drop, into mud.
sentences.zh: 在雷雨天里，我站在那里被雨水湿透，看着母犀牛们变了颜色，变成了巧克力色，闪闪发光，因为它们背上的灰尘一滴一滴地变成了泥浆。

sentences.en: One day, I held a cantaloupe-sized ball of rhino poop in my palm, then broke it in half.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我手里托着一个哈密瓜大小的犀牛粪球，然后把它掰成两半。

sentences.en: Pure grass.
sentences.zh: 纯草。

sentences.en: I spent an unbelievable number of hours just watching the girls graze.
sentences.zh: 我花了难以置信的许多个小时，只是静静地看着母犀牛吃草。

sentences.en: That might sound boring, but they elevate it to an art form.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能很无聊，但它们把这提升到了一门艺术的高度。

sentences.en: White rhinos eat so much grass that they are sometimes called grass rhinos.
sentences.zh: 白犀牛吃大量的草，以至于它们有时被称为食草犀牛。

sentences.en: Their mouths are perfectly designed for the task, in the same way that a great white shark's mouth is perfectly designed to eat seals.
sentences.zh: 它们的嘴是为这项任务完美设计的，就像大白鲨的嘴是为吃海豹完美设计的一样。

sentences.en: White rhino's snouts are flat, like vacuum attachments, and they tear the grass not with their teeth but with their lips, which are ridged to clamp the tiniest shoots.
sentences.zh: 白犀牛的吻部是平的，就像吸尘器的吸嘴，它们扯断草靠的不是牙齿而是嘴唇，嘴唇上有脊，可以夹住最小的嫩芽。

sentences.en: They can find grass in what looks like a bare patch of dirt.
sentences.zh: 它们能在看起来像是一片光秃秃的泥地的草地上找到草。

sentences.en: As they graze, the girls swing their heads back and forth, tearing and chewing, tearing and chewing, crunching every mouthful with the sound of muffled thunder.
sentences.zh: 在吃草时，母犀牛前后摇晃着脑袋，撕扯着，咀嚼着，每一次咀嚼都发出闷雷般的声音。

sentences.en: I kept wondering, how could these tiny plants support creatures so huge?
sentences.zh: 我不禁在想，这些细小的植物怎么能养活如此巨大的生物？

sentences.en: And how could grass ever be so loud?
sentences.zh: 草的声音怎么能这么响亮？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: One day just after dawn, I got to give Najin her morning scratchdown.
sentences.zh: 有一天黎明刚过，我有机会给娜金进行早晨的挠痒。

sentences.en: Jojo was scratching her as he did most mornings, and when he stopped, Najin stood there, waiting, seeming to want more.
sentences.zh: 乔乔像往常大多数早晨一样在给她挠痒，当他停下来时，娜金站在那里等待着，似乎还想要更多。

sentences.en: Jojo asked if I wanted to give it a try.
sentences.zh: 乔乔问我想不想试试。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我试了。

sentences.en: I walked over to the mother rhino, curled my fingers, and, a little hesitantly, much more tentatively than Jojo, started to scratch.
sentences.zh: 我走到母犀牛身边，蜷起手指，略带犹豫地、比乔乔试探得多地开始挠痒。

sentences.en: I scratched her temple, her neck, her big thick folds.
sentences.zh: 我挠了挠她的太阳穴、她的脖子、她厚厚的大褶皱。

sentences.en: I felt her roughness and her softness.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了她的粗糙和她的柔软。

sentences.en: I wasn't very good at it, to be honeSt. I was slightly scared, ready to sprint away at any moment.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我不太擅长。我有点害怕，随时准备着逃跑。

sentences.en: So I didn't really dig in like the caretakers, didn't commit my whole fragile body to the task, and I think Najin could tell.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有像饲养员那样真正用力地挠，没有把自己脆弱的身体全部投入到这项任务中，我想娜金能感觉得到。

sentences.en: But she stood there anyway, accepting it.
sentences.zh: 但她还是站在那里，全盘接受了。

sentences.en: And then when I stopped, she swiveled her long head over toward me, stared at me, held still.
sentences.zh: 然后当我停下来时，她把修长的脑袋转过来对着我，凝视着我，一动不动。

sentences.en: Jojo said this meant she was asking for more.
sentences.zh: 乔乔说这意味着她在索要更多。

sentences.en: So I kept scratching.
sentences.zh: 于是我继续挠着。

sentences.en: Most of us are taught that rhinos are exotic.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都被灌输这样一种观点：犀牛是充满异国情调的。

sentences.en: Perhaps no animal has been more widely misunderstood, especially in the WeSt. For over 1,000 years, the historian Kelly Enright points out, not a single rhino was seen in Europe.
sentences.zh: 也许没有任何动物比犀牛遭受过更多的误解，尤其是在西方。历史学家凯利·恩赖特指出，在1000多年的时间里，欧洲连一只犀牛都没有见到过。

sentences.en: In that absence, misinformation bloomed.
sentences.zh: 在这种缺席的情况下，谣言和错误信息滋生了。

sentences.en: According to the travels of Marco Polo, rhinos were very ugly unicorns that did not kill their enemies, as you might expect, with their horns.
sentences.zh: 根据马可·波罗的游记，犀牛是非常丑陋的独角兽，它们杀害敌人不是像你预期的那样用角，

sentences.en: They pinned them under their knees and licked them to death with their spiky tongues.
sentences.zh: 而是把敌人压在膝盖下，用它们带刺的舌头把敌人舔死。

sentences.en: Even today in the modern world, rhinos are mythologized and fetishized to the point of unreality.
sentences.zh: 即使在今天的现代世界中，犀牛也被神话化和恋物癖化，到了脱离现实的地步。

sentences.en: We look at them like dinosaurs who have outlasted their time, even though they are no older than horses.
sentences.zh: 我们把它们看作是早已过时的恐龙，尽管它们的历史并不比马更悠久。

sentences.en: We see their horns as strange and fantastical.
sentences.zh: 我们认为它们的角是奇怪而奇幻的。

sentences.en: But in fact, they are only compressed keratin, the same material that makes up our hair.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，它们只是压缩的角蛋白，也就是构成我们头发的同一种物质。

sentences.en: The same material, in fact, that made up the fingernails I was using to scratch
sentences.zh: 事实上，这也是构成我用来给娜金

sentences.en: Najin.
sentences.zh: 挠痒的手指甲的同一种物质。

sentences.en: Being with the girls, seeing the lives they share with their caretakers, is the perfect antidote to any exoticism.
sentences.zh: 和母犀牛在一起，看到它们与饲养员共享的生活，是消除任何异国情调幻想的绝佳解毒剂。

sentences.en: The men treat the rhinos like a cross between little sisters and very good dogs and prized cows and great grandmothers.
sentences.zh: 男人们把犀牛当作小妹妹、极好的狗狗、珍贵的奶牛和曾祖母的结合体来对待。

sentences.en: The relationship is not predatory, not extractive.
sentences.zh: 这种关系不是掠夺性的，也不是掠取性的。

sentences.en: All the small daily interactions, the petting and scratching, the nicknames, the looks,
sentences.zh: 所有日常的小互动，抚摸和挠痒，昵称，眼神，

sentences.en: are exchanges of currencies so ancient that they are impossible to hoard and hardly even need names.
sentences.zh: 都是古老到无法囤积、甚至几乎不需要名字的价值交换。

sentences.en: Kindness, comfort, friction, warmth, pleasure, presence, safety.
sentences.zh: 善良、慰藉、摩擦、温暖、快乐、陪伴、安全感。

sentences.en: Just down the road from the girls, Orpajetha has a rhinoceros memorial.
sentences.zh: 沿着公路再往下走不远，在奥佩热塔，有一座犀牛纪念碑。

sentences.en: It is a place of deep sadness.
sentences.zh: 这是一个充满深切悲伤的地方。

sentences.en: One tall tree stands alone in the middle of an open field, and around it sits a score of rough stone piles, each bearing a plaque with a rhino's name.
sentences.zh: 空旷的田野正中央孤零零地立着一棵高大的树，树周围散落着二十多堆粗糙的石头，每块石头上都刻着一头犀牛名字的铭牌。

sentences.en: A few of the honored animals were famous and highly protected, and therefore able to die of natural causes.
sentences.zh: 这些受纪念的动物中，有几头曾名声大噪且受到高度保护，因此得以寿终正寝。

sentences.en: Sunni and Sudan, for instance, the last two male northern whites.
sentences.zh: 例如逊尼和苏丹，最后仅存的两头雄性北方白犀。

sentences.en: But a vast majority were not famous, and their lives ended terribly at the hands of poachers.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数动物并不出名，它们的生命却惨死在偷猎者手中。

sentences.en: They were shot by guns or poison arrows, their horns cut off.
sentences.zh: 它们被枪击或毒箭射杀，犀角被硬生生割去。

sentences.en: I saw markers for rhinos called Carol, Mia, Shemsha, Zulu, Kaka, Batian.
sentences.zh: 我看到了为名叫卡罗尔、米娅、谢姆沙、祖鲁、卡卡、巴蒂安的犀牛设立的标记。

sentences.en: Some died quickly, but others survived for weeks before succumbing to their injuries.
sentences.zh: 有些很快就死了，但另一些在伤重离世前痛苦挣扎了好几周。

sentences.en: I saw a plaque for Ishirini, a 19-year-old black rhino.
sentences.zh: 我看到了一块为伊希里尼设立的铭牌，她是一头19岁的雌性黑犀牛。

sentences.en: The security team found her writhing in pain with the horns already chopped off.
sentences.zh: 安保团队发现她时，她正痛苦地蜷缩着身体，角已经被砍掉了。

sentences.en: She was 12 months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 当时她已经怀胎十二个月。

sentences.en: A 28-year-old named Job, semi-tame blind rhino shot dead in a rhino enclosure and both horns removed.
sentences.zh: 一头名叫乔布的28岁半驯化盲犀牛，在犀牛围场里被枪杀，两只角都被割掉了。

sentences.en: The names just kept coming.
sentences.zh: 名字一个接一个地出现。

sentences.en: Mwanzo, Kiriamiti, Mwigo, Chema.
sentences.zh: 姆万佐、基里亚米蒂、姆维戈、切玛。

sentences.en: Max, a six-year-old white rhino, had had his horns preemptively sawed off by rangers to dissuade the poachers.
sentences.zh: 马克斯是一头六岁的白犀牛，为了打消偷猎者的念头，护林员提前锯掉了他的角。

sentences.en: But the poachers shot him anyway, perhaps just out of spite.
sentences.zh: 但偷猎者还是向他开了枪，也许仅仅出于恶意。

sentences.en: Even on a wildlife conservancy, it is impossible to protect every animal.
sentences.zh: 即便在野生动物保护区内，也不可能保护每一只动物。

sentences.en: Orpajet is huge, and it is surrounded on every side by desperate poverty.
sentences.zh: 奥佩热面积广阔，四面八方都被极度贫困所包围。

sentences.en: On the black market, rhino horn is worth more than gold.
sentences.zh: 在黑市上，犀牛角的价值超过了黄金。

sentences.en: The law of supply and demand dictates that the closer rhinos get to extinction, the more valuable their horns become.
sentences.zh: 供求规律表明，犀牛越接近灭亡，其犀牛角就越珍贵。

sentences.en: Although the killing happens locally, the market is international and controlled by highly organized crime syndicates.
sentences.zh: 尽管杀戮发生在当地，但市场却是国际化的，并由高度有组织的犯罪集团操控。

sentences.en: Powdered rhino horn, in fact, is sometimes consumed like a drug.
sentences.zh: 事实上，犀牛角粉有时会被当成毒品来消费。

sentences.en: People mix it with wine at parties in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 人们在越南的派对上把它混入酒中。

sentences.en: In recent years, poaching has increased rapidly.
sentences.zh: 近年来，偷猎活动急剧增加。

sentences.en: The girls, in the absence of armed guards, would probably be killed immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果没有武装警卫，这些女孩可能瞬间就会被杀害。

sentences.en: Some billionaire would no doubt pay a fortune to own the horns of the last two northern whites.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，会有某位亿万富翁花大价钱买下最后两头北方白犀的角。

sentences.en: In the face of all this gloom, and against very steep odds, there is still a last-ditch effort to save the subspecies.
sentences.zh: 面对这一切阴霾，在极其渺茫的希望面前，人们仍然在做着拯救这个亚种的最后一搏。

sentences.en: Since the 1970s, scientists have been collecting tissues from the northern whites.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪70年代以来，科学家们一直在收集北方白犀的组织。

sentences.en: Many of these are housed at several hundred degrees below zero in the frozen zoo, part of a San Diego research center.
sentences.zh: 其中许多组织被存放在冷冻动物园零下几百度深低温环境中，这是圣迭戈研究中心的一部分。

sentences.en: Like many large animals, rhinos are finicky breeders.
sentences.zh: 就像许多大型动物一样，犀牛对繁殖非常挑剔。

sentences.en: Both Najin and Fatu have reproductive probleMs. Neither can carry a baby to term.
sentences.zh: 纳金和法图都有生殖问题。两头都无法完成足月妊娠。

sentences.en: But their eggs, fertilized with frozen sperm and implanted into the uterus of a healthy southern white rhino, may still be able to create a viable calf.
sentences.zh: 但它们的卵子如果用冷冻精子受精，并植入健康的南方白犀代孕母体内，或许仍能孕育出健康的小犀牛。

sentences.en: It is a reproductive Hail Mary, but it is also the best option left.
sentences.zh: 这是生殖医学上孤注一掷的最后一招，但也是目前仅存的最佳选择。

sentences.en: My visit to Kenya came just a few weeks before the first attempt to extract the girls' eggs, a major operation that had everyone nervous.
sentences.zh: 我访问肯尼亚的时间，正值第一次提取女孩们卵子的几周前，这是一场让所有人都神经紧绷的大手术。

sentences.en: Some of the possible outcomes were bad.
sentences.zh: 某些可能的结果并不乐观。

sentences.en: They might have no eggs, or no viable eggs, or the operation could go wrong, and one or both of the animals could die.
sentences.zh: 它们可能没有卵子，或者没有可用的卵子，或者手术可能出错，一头甚至两头动物都会死去。

sentences.en: Zachariah Mutai, the head rhino caretaker, and a quiet, stoic man, told me that he was so stressed he was having trouble sleeping.
sentences.zh: 首席犀牛饲养员扎卡里亚·穆泰是一个安静、坚毅的人，他告诉我，他压力大到觉都睡不好。

sentences.en: It's delicate, James Muenda told me.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·穆恩达告诉我，这很微妙。

sentences.en: It's demanding.
sentences.zh: 要求很高。

sentences.en: It's difficult for the animals.
sentences.zh: 对动物来说很难。

sentences.en: Maybe it's not always succeeding.
sentences.zh: 也许并非总能成功。

sentences.en: Anything we are leaving room for.
sentences.zh: 任何可能发生的情况我们都留有余地。

sentences.en: But it's the only way out.
sentences.zh: 但这是唯一的出路。

sentences.en: We have to try.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尝试。

sentences.en: If that's not successful, Elodie Semperi, or Pejeta's media liaison said, then the only option left is basically stem cells.
sentences.zh: 奥佩热的媒体联络员埃洛迪·森佩里说，如果这不成功，那么剩下的唯一选择基本上就是干细胞了。

sentences.en: Jurassic Park, more or less.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是《侏罗纪公园》那一套。

sentences.en: The question is harsh, but must be asked.
sentences.zh: 这个问题很残酷，但又不得不问。

sentences.en: Why save one particular subspecies of rhino?
sentences.zh: 为什么要拯救某个特定的犀牛亚种？

sentences.en: Our planet, cynics will tell you, is not a museum.
sentences.zh: 犬儒主义者会告诉你，我们的星球不是博物馆。

sentences.en: We have no sacred duty to the ecological status quo.
sentences.zh: 我们对生态现状没有神圣的责任。

sentences.en: Nature is brutal.
sentences.zh: 大自然是残酷的。

sentences.en: Variants come and go.
sentences.zh: 物种变体来来去去。

sentences.en: We have already lost the giraffe rhinoceros and the woolly rhinoceros, and more than 100 other kinds of ancient rhinos, and we seem to be getting along just fine.
sentences.zh: 我们已经失去了长颈犀牛和披毛犀，以及其他100多种古代犀牛，而我们似乎过得也挺好。

sentences.en: Conservation is largely sentimentality.
sentences.zh: 保护工作很大程度上只是多愁善感。

sentences.en: The answer to this is, first of all, to knock the cynic's hat off, preferably into a wet gutter, and then to kick it a little farther away every time he tries to pick it up.
sentences.zh: 对这种观点的回应，首先是一巴掌打飞犬儒主义者的帽子，最好把它打进湿漉漉的下水道里，然后每当他试图去捡时，再把它踢得更远一点。

sentences.en: Then point out that nothing exists in isolation.
sentences.zh: 接着指出，没有任何事物是孤立存在的。

sentences.en: A rhino is not just a rhino.
sentences.zh: 一头犀牛不仅仅是一头犀牛。

sentences.en: It is a load-bearing strand in an elaborate ecological web.
sentences.zh: 它是复杂的生态网络中一根承重的支柱。

sentences.en: Just by going about its day, a rhinoceros helps keep its whole environment healthy.
sentences.zh: 仅仅通过日常的活动，一头犀牛就能帮助维持其整个环境的健康。

sentences.en: Its grazing mows and plows the fields.
sentences.zh: 它的吃草行为就像是在修剪和耕耘田野。

sentences.en: Its daily walks clear paths through the bush, leaving hard, flat roads for other animals to follow.
sentences.zh: 它日常散步在灌木丛中踩出小路，为其他动物留下了坚硬平坦的道路。

sentences.en: A rhino's dung feeds colonies of insects, and birds come to feed on the insects, and other predators come to catch the birds.
sentences.zh: 犀牛的粪便滋养了昆虫群落，鸟类赶来以昆虫为食，而其他捕食者又赶来捕食鸟类。

sentences.en: A rhino is not just part of the world.
sentences.zh: 犀牛不仅是世界的一部分。

sentences.en: It is a world.
sentences.zh: 它本身就是一个世界。

sentences.en: Everywhere it goes, it moves in swirling clouds of ox-peckers and egrets and guinea fowl.
sentences.zh: 无论它走到哪里，身边总是环绕着红嘴牛椋鸟、白鹭和珠鸡盘旋的云团。

sentences.en: Humans like to pretend that we can stand apart from such elaborate interconnections, from the vast web of non-human life.
sentences.zh: 人类喜欢假装我们可以置身于这种复杂的相互联系之外，置身于庞大的非人类生命网络之外。

sentences.en: But we, too, are a part of that web, and sooner or later, our strand will be cut.
sentences.zh: 但我们也是这个网络的一部分，迟早有一天，属于我们的这根线会被剪断。

sentences.en: At some point, we have to talk about love,
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，我们必须谈谈爱，

sentences.en: about rhinos as givers and receivers of love.
sentences.zh: 谈谈作为爱的给予者和接受者的犀牛。

sentences.en: We don't live in a culture that encourages this.
sentences.zh: 我们生活的文化并不鼓励这一点。

sentences.en: Love is not quantifiable.
sentences.zh: 爱是无法量化的。

sentences.en: It doesn't generate doomed statistics.
sentences.zh: 它不会产生注定悲剧的统计数据。

sentences.en: It is ignored in policy debates.
sentences.zh: 它在政策辩论中被忽视了。

sentences.en: And yet, in the end, love is the source of all our meaningful values.
sentences.zh: 然而，归根结底，爱是我们所有有意义价值的源泉。

sentences.en: Clearly, Najin and Fatu love each other.
sentences.zh: 显然，纳金和法图彼此相爱。

sentences.en: They are mother and daughter mammals.
sentences.zh: 它们是身为哺乳动物的母女。

sentences.en: They seek each other's presence and warmth and touch.
sentences.zh: 它们渴望彼此的陪伴、温暖和触碰。

sentences.en: In the wild, female white rhinos tend to be social, living with their calves in groups of about a dozen.
sentences.zh: 在野外，雌性白犀牛往往具有社交性，与它们的幼崽以大约一打为一组的形式生活在一起。

sentences.en: But the girls had only each other, day after day.
sentences.zh: 但女孩们日复一日，只有彼此相依。

sentences.en: Sometimes I tried to imagine Najin without Fatu or Fatu without Najin, and it made me extremely sad.
sentences.zh: 有时我试着想象没有法图的纳金，或者没有纳金的法图，这让我感到无比悲伤。

sentences.en: The caretakers, too, very obviously loved the girls.
sentences.zh: 饲养员们显然也深爱着这些女孩。

sentences.en: And the girls, as much as rhinos can, seemed to love them back.
sentences.zh: 而在犀牛所能表达的范围内，女孩们似乎也给予了回爱。

sentences.en: After just a couple of hours, I, too, was in love with these creatures, especially with Najin, whom I wanted to stand next to and actually be hugging at all times.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几个小时后，我也爱上了这些生物，尤其是纳金，我很想紧挨着她，随时随刻都能拥抱她。

sentences.en: Moenda said I should absolutely not hug her.
sentences.zh: 穆恩达说我绝对不能抱她。

sentences.en: Your daughter and son need you back, is how he put it.
sentences.zh: 他是这样说的：你的女儿和儿子还需要你回去。

sentences.en: Falling in love with the girls up close made me think about one of our most basic human conundruMs. Love has a range.
sentences.zh: 近距离爱上这些女孩，让我思考起人类最基本的困境之一：爱的范围是有限的。

sentences.en: We are built to love, and we can summon that love to do nearly impossible things.
sentences.zh: 我们生来就会爱，我们能够调动这种爱去完成几乎不可能的事情。

sentences.en: And yet that love is an outer range of maybe thirty yards.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种爱的极限范围大约只有三十码。

sentences.en: It's like a wonderful lamp.
sentences.zh: 它就像一盏奇妙的灯。

sentences.en: It fills the inside of our houses.
sentences.zh: 它照亮了我们房屋的内部。

sentences.en: It washes over our families and our pets.
sentences.zh: 它沐浴着我们的家人和宠物。

sentences.en: It extends as we walk to the town around us.
sentences.zh: 当我们走向周围的城镇时，它随之延伸。

sentences.en: But it cannot leap with any of the necessary intensity across city limits or state lines or oceans.
sentences.zh: 但它无法带着任何必要的强度跨越城市边界、州界或海洋。

sentences.en: It cannot leap, except abstractly, with great effort to distant people in need or to strange, threatened animals.
sentences.zh: 除了抽象的、付出巨大努力的方式之外，它无法跨越去关爱远方需要帮助的人或受到威胁的奇异动物。

sentences.en: We love, really love, what is near us, what we have touched, what loves us back.
sentences.zh: 我们所爱并真正深爱的，是离我们近的、我们触摸过的、也爱我们的人。

sentences.en: Those limitations are a problem when it comes to a crisis like mass extinction.
sentences.zh: 当面对大灭绝这样的危机时，这些局限性就成了一个问题。

sentences.en: All 7.7 billion humans cannot possibly come and spend a week with the girls, which means that humanity at large will never give Najin her morning scratchdown and feel her warm,
sentences.zh: 全人类77亿人不可能都来和这些女孩共度一周，这意味着广大公众永远不会去给纳金早晨挠痒痒，也永远感受不到她那温暖、

sentences.en: grunting breath.
sentences.zh: 发出呼噜声的呼吸。

sentences.en: Humanity at large will never truly love them.
sentences.zh: 广大公众永远不会真正爱上它们。

sentences.en: And so we will never act collectively with the urgency that befits true love, the only kind of urgency that might work.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们永远不会以符合真爱的紧迫感采取集体行动，而这才是唯一可能奏效的紧迫感。

sentences.en: And that's just the girls, two particularly charismatic animals right on the brink of extinction.
sentences.zh: 这还只是针对女孩们，两头正处于灭绝边缘、极具个人魅力的动物。

sentences.en: What about, let's say, the Northwest Bornean orangutan, an orange ape whose cheeks look as if they are being pinched and stretched by a very enthusiastic grandmother?
sentences.zh: 那么，比方说，西北婆罗洲猩猩呢？那是一种橙色的大猩猩，它的脸颊看起来就像是被一位极其热情的祖母捏住并拉伸着一样。

sentences.en: There are about 1,500 left.
sentences.zh: 现在大约只剩下1500只了。

sentences.en: What about the black-footed ferret, sneaky little fur tube of the Great Plains?
sentences.zh: 那黑足雪貂呢？大平原上鬼鬼祟祟的毛茸茸小管子。

sentences.en: There are fewer than 400 left in the wild.
sentences.zh: 野外仅存不到400只。

sentences.en: The humphead wrasse, the giant panda, the dugong, the hawksbill turtle, the polar bear, the cross-river gorilla, the monarch butterfly.
sentences.zh: 苏眉鱼、大熊猫、儒艮、玳瑁、北极熊、克罗斯河大猩猩、帝王斑蝶。

sentences.en: What about the whole Amazon rainforest?
sentences.zh: 整个亚马逊雨林呢？

sentences.en: What about the coral reefs?
sentences.zh: 珊瑚礁呢？

sentences.en: We have to proceed somehow as if our love extended to creatures and places it could extend to but does not.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我们必须继续前行，就好像我们的爱能够延伸到那些它本可以延伸却尚未延伸到的生物和地方一样。

sentences.en: We need to fit humanity with some kind of prosthetic love extensions.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为人类装上某种假体般的爱的延伸器。

sentences.en: The girls do not exist for us.
sentences.zh: 女孩们并不是为了我们而存在的。

sentences.en: They are not symbols or oracles.
sentences.zh: 它们不是符号或神谕。

sentences.en: They are not there to answer our existential questions or to help us save the world.
sentences.zh: 它们存在不是为了回答我们的存在主义问题，也不是为了帮我们拯救世界。

sentences.en: They are something better and simpler.
sentences.zh: 它们是更好、更单纯的存在。

sentences.en: They are the girls.
sentences.zh: 它们就是女孩们。

sentences.en: On my last day in Kenya, I walked to the water trough and said goodbye to Najin.
sentences.zh: 在我呆在肯尼亚的最后一天，我走到水槽边，向纳金告别。

sentences.en: She reached her head out toward me, with that deadly horn extended, and just looked.
sentences.zh: 她把头朝我伸过来，亮出那支致命的角，只是静静地看着。

sentences.en: She stood still, bulky, watching me, and I watched her back.
sentences.zh: 她一动不动地站着，庞大而笨重地注视着我，我也回望着她。

sentences.en: After a while, she bent her neck down to take one of her long, quiet drinks.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她低下脖子，开始安安静静地喝着长长的一口水。

sentences.en: Then she looked back up at me, her snout shining with water.
sentences.zh: 然后她抬起头看着我，她的鼻吻部沾满了水，闪闪发光。

sentences.en: I reached my hand out and touched her horn, cautiously, twice.
sentences.zh: 我伸出手，小心翼翼地碰了碰她的角两次。

sentences.en: She stood still, staring.
sentences.zh: 她静静地站着，凝视着。

sentences.en: I told Najin that it had been very nice to meet her.
sentences.zh: 我告诉纳金，很高兴能认识她。

sentences.en: I could not make myself walk away.
sentences.zh: 我怎么也迈不开脚步离开。

sentences.en: As long as I stayed close to the girls, they would continue to fill my whole vision.
sentences.zh: 只要我待在女孩们身边，它们就会一直填满我的整个视野。

sentences.en: Najin stared at me for a while longer, snuffling gently.
sentences.zh: 纳金又盯着我看了一会儿，轻轻地吸了吸鼻子。

sentences.en: Then she turned and walked away.
sentences.zh: 然后她转过身走开了。

sentences.en: Of course, I could not stay with the girls.
sentences.zh: 当然，我不可能一直和女孩们待在一起。

sentences.en: I had to go back home.
sentences.zh: 我必须回家了。

sentences.en: A few weeks after I left, in August 2019, I learned that the egg extraction operation had been a success.
sentences.zh: 在我离开几周后，即2019年8月，我得知卵子提取手术成功了。

sentences.en: The girls were fine, and the team of scientists had indeed managed to harvest some eggs, five from Fatu, five from Najin.
sentences.zh: 女孩们状况良好，科学家团队确实成功采集了一些卵子，法图5枚，纳金5枚。

sentences.en: Seven of these were successfully fertilized.
sentences.zh: 其中七枚成功受精。

sentences.en: Of those seven, three went on to become embryos.
sentences.zh: 在这七枚中，有三枚发育成了胚胎。

sentences.en: They now sit in a deep freeze, waiting for the next uncertain steps.
sentences.zh: 它们现在躺在深冷冻柜里，等待着下一个充满不确定性的步骤。

sentences.en: Implantation, gestation, potentially, someday, a birth.
sentences.zh: 植入、妊娠，潜在地，在某一天，诞生新生命。

sentences.en: It is still a long shot, and researchers caution that it could take many years, and that even if everything goes perfectly, in the labs and in the fields, there may not be enough
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个渺茫的希望，研究人员警告说这可能需要很多年，并且即使实验室和野外的一切都完美无缺，也可能没有足够

sentences.en: genetic diversity left to seed a new population of healthy northern whites.
sentences.zh: 的遗传多样性来培育出一群健康的北方白犀新种群。

sentences.en: The girls, meanwhile, walked back out to the field to do what they had always done.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，女孩们走回了田野，去做它们一直以来都在做的事。

sentences.en: Back home, I looked constantly at my photos and videos of the rhinos, trying to hold on to my time with them.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，我不断地看着自己拍的犀牛照片和视频，试图留住和它们在一起的时光。

sentences.en: But inevitably, gradually, they slipped away.
sentences.zh: 但不可避免地，渐渐地，它们溜走了。

sentences.en: Their massive presence turned into a massive absence.
sentences.zh: 它们庞大的存在变成了一种巨大的缺席。

sentences.en: Some months later, as I was trying to write about the girls, trying to bring them to life on the page, a global pandemic hit.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，当我正试图写关于女孩们的文章、试图在纸面上让它们重现生机时，一场全球大流行爆发了。

sentences.en: The whole world shut down.
sentences.zh: 整个世界都停摆了。

sentences.en: They were all suddenly absent to one another.
sentences.zh: 它们突然对彼此全都缺席了。

sentences.en: It was hard to focus on the crisis of mass extinction when our own species was suffering and dying right in front of us at such an alarming rate.
sentences.zh: 当人类自身的物种正以如此惊人的速度在我们眼前遭受痛苦和死亡时，我们很难将注意力集中在大灭绝危机上。

sentences.en: Still, the girls continued to roam through my mind.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，女孩们依然在我的脑海中盘旋。

sentences.en: In this moment of total upheaval, I found their existence to be anchoring, the knowledge that they were both still out there
sentences.zh: 在这个天翻地覆的时刻，我发现它们的存在给予了我精神的锚定，得知它们俩依然都在

sentences.en: in the field side by side, chewing grass under thunderous skies, living, as Wendell Berry once wrote,
sentences.zh: 那片田野里并肩漫步，在雷雨交加的天空下咀嚼青草，正如温德尔·贝里曾经写的那样，

sentences.en: with the peace of wild things who do not tax their lives with forethought of grief.
sentences.zh: 怀着野生生物的平静，不让对悲伤的预想累赘它们的生活。

sentences.en: I kept remembering in particular one moment out in the field.
sentences.zh: 我特别留恋野外经历过的一个瞬间。

sentences.en: Have you ever heard a rhino snoring before?
sentences.zh: 你以前听过犀牛打呼噜吗？

sentences.en: James Mwenda asked me one afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，詹姆斯·姆文达问我。

sentences.en: We were sitting on the edge of a hole, an old aardvark den that had collapsed and was now used mainly by warthogs.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在一个土坑边缘，那是一个老旧的土豚洞穴，已经坍塌，现在主要被疣猪占用。

sentences.en: The girls were napping nearby.
sentences.zh: 几个女孩正在附近打盹。

sentences.en: All around us, the birds were stitching their crazy quilt of songs, hooting, chipping, whirring, beeping, cooing, grinding, sliding.
sentences.zh: 在我们周围，各种鸟类编织着它们疯狂的交响乐，鸣叫、啼转、蜂鸣、尖叫、咕咕、磨擦、滑音。

sentences.en: And yes, in the midst of all that noise, like a distant tractor gently idling, one of the rhinos was snoring.
sentences.zh: 是的，在所有这些噪音中，其中一只犀牛正在打呼噜，就像远处的拖拉机在温和地空转。

sentences.en: It was indeed my first time.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我的第一次。

sentences.en: And yet the sound was familiar, exactly the same kind of rhythmic rasp you would hear coming out of your stepfather, or your pet dog, or your best friend.
sentences.zh: 然而这个声音是那么熟悉，正是那种你会从你继父、宠物狗或挚友身上听到的有节奏的粗喘声。

sentences.en: It was just a regular old snore, the universal soundtrack of a mammal deep in slumber.
sentences.zh: 这只是一场普通的老式呼噜声，是沉睡中哺乳动物的宇宙级配乐。

sentences.en: The noise was coming from Najin.
sentences.zh: 声音是从纳金那里传出来的。

sentences.en: Fatu was sleeping silently next to her, her big square snout mashed on the ground, her legs curled under her like a kitten's.
sentences.zh: 法图在她身旁静静地睡着，她那巨大的方形口鼻部紧贴着地面，双腿像小猫一样蜷缩在身下。

sentences.en: The two of them looked armored but defenseless, adorable, and sad.
sentences.zh: 她俩看起来既有盔甲保护又毫无防备，既可爱又让人心疼。

sentences.en: Watching the girls take naps was always one of my favorite things, because it required every time an elaborate and tender choreography.
sentences.zh: 看着女孩们小睡一直是我最喜欢的事情之一，因为每次都需要一套精心而温柔的编排。

sentences.en: Najin, hobbling a bit because of her weak back legs, would choose a spot to lie down on,
sentences.zh: 纳金因为后腿无力而有些跛行，它会挑一个地方躺下，

sentences.en: while Fatu stood guard over her, waiting patiently, making sure the field was safe for sleep.
sentences.zh: 而法图则在一旁守卫，耐心地等待，确保野外睡觉是安全的。

sentences.en: Only after Najin had slid her huge bulk entirely to the ground could Fatu rest herself.
sentences.zh: 只有当纳金庞大的身躯完全滑倒在地上后，法图才能让自己休息。

sentences.en: Before she did, however, she would essentially cuddle with her mother, tip her head down,
sentences.zh: 然而，在此之前，它基本上会和母亲依偎在一起，把头低下来，

sentences.en: and touch her own front horn gently to her mother's front horn, then press her body into her mother's body.
sentences.zh: 把自己的前角轻轻贴在母亲的前角上，然后把身体紧贴在母亲的身体上。

sentences.en: And Fatu would slide down flat, a few feet away from Najin.
sentences.zh: 接着法图会平平地滑倒在离纳金几英尺远的地方。

sentences.en: I could not get enough of watching them sleep, because of course, a northern white rhino nap was never just a regular nap.
sentences.zh: 我怎么也看不够它们睡觉，因为当然了，北方白犀牛的小睡绝不仅仅是一场普通的小睡。

sentences.en: Every time the girls closed their eyes, all the northern white rhino consciousness left on planet
sentences.zh: 每次女孩们闭上眼睛，地球上所有残存的

sentences.en: Earth temporarily blinked out.
sentences.zh: 北方白犀牛意识就会暂时熄灭。

sentences.en: And when they woke up, it blinked back on again.
sentences.zh: 当它们醒来时，意识又重新亮起。

sentences.en: Suddenly, in the midst of
sentences.zh: 突然，在

sentences.en: Najin's snoring, another sound broke out over the field, a rumble even louder than the snore.
sentences.zh: 纳金的呼噜声中，野外传出了另一种声音，一种比呼噜声还要响亮的隆隆声。

sentences.en: This new noise went on and on.
sentences.zh: 这个新声音持续了很久很久。

sentences.en: It sounded like a trombonist warming up, feeling out the acoustics of a very large concert hall.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像一个长号手在热身，试探着大型音乐厅的声学效果。

sentences.en: This was, it became clear, a rhinoceros fart.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这是一声犀牛屁。

sentences.en: One of the girls was breaking wind in her sleep, emphatically, sincerely, admirably, without restraint.
sentences.zh: 其中一个女孩在睡梦中放了屁，那么铿锵有力、真诚坦荡、令人钦佩，毫无保留。

sentences.en: Once the noise died down, I asked Mawenda if he could tell which of the rhinos had done it.
sentences.zh: 等声音平息后，我问姆文达他能否分辨出是哪只犀牛放的。

sentences.en: He laughed.
sentences.zh: 他笑了。

sentences.en: The two of them, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，是它们两个。

sentences.en: The two of them together.
sentences.zh: 它们两个一起放的。

sentences.en: They did it at once.
sentences.zh: 它们同时放的。

sentences.en: This struck me in that moment as the very definition of magic, and I laughed with crazy joy.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，这让我觉得这就是魔法的定义，我带着疯狂的喜悦大笑起来。

sentences.en: Life speaks to us in so many languages.
sentences.zh: 生命用如此多的语言对我们倾诉。

sentences.en: The last two northern white rhinos, mother and daughter, had passed gas together, in perfect unison, in the middle of a happy sleep.
sentences.zh: 最后两头北方白犀牛，母女俩，在幸福的睡梦中，以完美的齐步，一起放了屁。

sentences.en: Mawenda and I had just heard the rarest symphony in the world.
sentences.zh: 我和姆文达刚刚听到了世界上最稀有的交响乐。

sentences.en: One biological chord, rising, fading, dispersing, expanding.
sentences.zh: 一个生物学的和弦，升起、渐弱、消散、扩散。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就黑灯瞎火睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
